flavor_text: It spits outPOISONPOWDER toimmobilize theenemy and thenfinishes it witha spray of ACID.
name: Weepinbell

flavor_text: Said to live inhuge coloniesdeep in jungles,although no onehas ever returnedfrom there.
name: Victreebel

flavor_text: Tentacool is not a particularly strong swimmer.It drifts across the surface of shallow seas as itsearches for prey.
name: Tentacool

flavor_text: This Pokémon is mostly made of water.A Tentacool out in the ocean is very hard tospot, because its body blends in with the sea.
name: Tentacool

flavor_text: When the red orbs on Tentacruel’s head glowbrightly, watch out. The Pokémon is about tofire off a burst of ultrasonic waves.
name: Tentacruel

flavor_text: Its 80 tentacles can stretch and shrink freely.Tentacruel ensnares prey in a net of spread-outtentacles, delivering venomous stings to its catch.
name: Tentacruel

flavor_text: Found in fieldsand mountains.Mistaking themfor boulders,people often stepor trip on them.
name: Geodude

flavor_text: Rolls down slopesto move. It rollsover any obstaclewithout slowingor changing itsdirection.
name: Graveler

flavor_text: Its boulder-likebody is extremelyhard. It caneasily withstanddynamite blastswithout damage.
name: Golem

flavor_text: It can’t run properly when it’s newly born.As it races around with others of its kind,its legs grow stronger.
name: Ponyta

flavor_text: If you’ve been accepted by Ponyta, its burningmane is mysteriously no longer hot to the touch.
name: Ponyta

flavor_text: This Pokémon can be seen galloping throughfields at speeds of up to 150 mph, its fiery manefluttering in the wind.
name: Rapidash

flavor_text: The fastest runner becomes the leader, and itdecides the herd’s pace and direction of travel.
name: Rapidash

flavor_text: Slow-witted and oblivious, this Pokémon won’tfeel any pain if its tail gets eaten. It won’t noticewhen its tail grows back, either.
name: Slowpoke

flavor_text: When this Pokémon’s tail is soaked in water,sweetness seeps from it. Slowpoke uses this traitto lure in and fish up other Pokémon.
name: Slowpoke

flavor_text: To survive in the cold waters of Galar, thisPokémon forms a dome with its legs, enclosingits body so it can capture its own body heat.
name: Toxapex

flavor_text: Within the poison sac in its body is a poison sotoxic that Pokémon as large as Wailord will stillbe suffering three days after it first takes effect.
name: Toxapex

flavor_text: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles usingwater balloons created with moisture secretedfrom its palms.
name: Drizzile

flavor_text: Highly intelligent but also very lazy,it keeps enemies out of its territoryby laying traps everywhere.
name: Drizzile

flavor_text: It begins walking on its hind legs after evolution.It can punch holes through boulders with its horn.
name: Rhydon

flavor_text: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable ofliving in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.
name: Rhydon

flavor_text: Using its psychic power, Kadabra levitates as itsleeps. It uses its springy tail as a pillow.
name: Kadabra

flavor_text: This Pokémon’s telekinesis is immensely powerful.To prepare for evolution, Kadabra stores uppsychic energy in the star on its forehead.
name: Kadabra

flavor_text: The egg Chansey carries is not only deliciousbut also packed with nutrition. It’s used as ahigh-class cooking ingredient.
name: Chansey

flavor_text: This species was once very slow. To protect theireggs from other creatures, these Pokémonbecame able to flee quickly.
name: Chansey

flavor_text: The dense fog it creates brings the downfalland destruction of its confused enemies.Ocean currents are the source of its energy.
name: Tapu Fini

flavor_text: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that growsnonstop even if the vines are torn off, thisPokémon’s true appearance remains a mystery.
name: Tangela

flavor_text: The vines of a Tangela have a distinct scent.In some parts of Galar, Tangela vines are usedas herbs.
name: Tangela

flavor_text: Although it’s carrying its baby in a pouch onits belly, Kangaskhan is swift on its feet. Itintimidates its opponents with quick jabs.
name: Kangaskhan

flavor_text: There are records of a lost human child beingraised by a childless Kangaskhan.
name: Kangaskhan

flavor_text: It has a preference for hot things. When it rains,steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.
name: Charmander

flavor_text: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tipof its tail. Its life would end if the flame were togo out.
name: Charmander

flavor_text: It has a barbaric nature. In battle, it whips itsfiery tail around and slashes away with sharp claws.
name: Charmeleon

flavor_text: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spoutsintense flames, incinerating its surroundings.
name: Charmeleon

flavor_text: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders.It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.
name: Charizard

flavor_text: Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to analtitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at veryhigh temperatures.
name: Charizard

flavor_text: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, itsquirts out water with vigorous force.
name: Squirtle

flavor_text: When it feels threatened, it draws its limbs insideits shell and sprays water from its mouth.
name: Squirtle

flavor_text: There is a plant seed on its back right from theday this Pokémon is born. The seed slowlygrows larger.
name: Bulbasaur

flavor_text: While it is young, it uses the nutrients that arestored in the seed on its back in order to grow.
name: Bulbasaur

flavor_text: When the bulb on its back grows large, itappears to lose the ability to stand on itshind legs.
name: Ivysaur

flavor_text: Exposure to sunlight adds to its strength.Sunlight also makes the bud on its backgrow larger.
name: Ivysaur

flavor_text: Its plant blooms when it is absorbing solarenergy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.
name: Venusaur

flavor_text: A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower.The fragrance becalms those engagedin a battle.
name: Venusaur

flavor_text: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears packthe chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackerswon’t be able to resist weeping.
name: Sobble

flavor_text: When it gets wet, its skin changes color,and this Pokémon becomes invisible as ifit were camouflaged.
name: Sobble

flavor_text: It’s the males that raise the offspring. WhileSeadra are raising young, the spines on theirbacks secrete thicker and stronger poison.
name: Seadra

flavor_text: Seadra’s mouth is slender, but its suction poweris strong. In an instant, Seadra can suck in foodthat’s larger than the opening of its mouth.
name: Seadra

flavor_text: It is recognized as a symbol of longevity. If itsshell has algae on it, that Wartortle is very old.
name: Wartortle

flavor_text: It cleverly controls its furry ears and tail tomaintain its balance while swimming.
name: Wartortle

flavor_text: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to causefainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.
name: Blastoise

flavor_text: The rocket cannons on its shell fire jets of watercapable of punching holes through thick steel.
name: Blastoise

flavor_text: It likes to makeits shell thickerby adding layersof tree bark. Theadditional weightdoesn't bother it.
name: Pineco

flavor_text: Its dorsal, pectoral, and tail fins wave elegantlyin water. That is why it is known as the Water Dancer.
name: Goldeen

flavor_text: Its dorsal and pectoral fins are strongly developedlike muscles. It can swim at a speed of five knots.
name: Goldeen

flavor_text: This Pokémon’s tiny wings have some scientistssaying that Dunsparce used to fly through the skyin ancient times.
name: Dunsparce

flavor_text: The nests Dunsparce live in are mazes of tunnels.They never get lost in their own nests—they cantell where they are by the scent of the dirt.
name: Dunsparce

flavor_text: It flies straightat its target'sface then clampsdown on the star­tled victim toinject poison.
name: Gligar

flavor_text: It likes playingmischievous trickssuch as screamingand wailing tostartle people atnight.
name: Misdreavus

flavor_text: Their shapes looklike hieroglyphson ancient tab­lets. It is saidthat the two aresomehow related.
name: Unown

flavor_text: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates itsbody to pump up its counterstrike.
name: Wobbuffet

flavor_text: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietlyin the darkness. It is never first to attack.
name: Wobbuffet

flavor_text: In autumn, its body becomes more fatty inpreparing to propose to a mate. It takes onbeautiful colors.
name: Seaking

flavor_text: Using its horn, it bores holes in riverbedboulders, making nests to prevent its eggs fromwashing away.
name: Seaking

flavor_text: It moves with blinding speed and lobs poison atfoes. Featuring Accelgor as a main character isa surefire way to make a movie or comic popular.
name: Accelgor

flavor_text: Discarding its shell made it nimble. To keepitself from dehydrating, it wraps its body inbands of membrane.
name: Accelgor

flavor_text: When attacked, it tightly shuts the lid of its shell.This reaction fails to protect it from Karrablast,however, because they can still get into the shell.
name: Shelmet

flavor_text: It has a strange physiology that responds toelectricity. When together with Karrablast,Shelmet evolves for some reason.
name: Shelmet

flavor_text: With its icy chains, Cryogonal freezes those itencounters. It then takes its victims away tosomewhere unknown.
name: Cryogonal

flavor_text: When the weather gets hot, these Pokémon turninto water vapor. Cryogonal are almost neverseen during summer.
name: Cryogonal

flavor_text: It swims through frigid seas, searching for prey.From its frozen breath, it forms icy fangs thatare harder than steel.
name: Beartic

flavor_text: It swims energetically through frigid seas.When it gets tired, it freezes the seawaterwith its breath so it can rest on the ice.
name: Beartic

flavor_text: It is said that if an Onix lives for over 100 years,its composition changes to become diamond-like.
name: Steelix

flavor_text: It is thought its body transformed as a result ofiron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.
name: Steelix

flavor_text: Although it looksfrightening, it isactually kind andaffectionate. Itis very popularamong women.
name: Snubbull

flavor_text: After battle, this Pokémon carefully sharpens itstusks on river rocks. It needs to take care of itstusks—if one breaks, it will never grow back.
name: Fraxure

flavor_text: Its skin is as hard as a suit of armor. Fraxure’sfavorite strategy is to tackle its opponents,stabbing them with its tusks at the same time.
name: Fraxure

flavor_text: These Pokémon nest in the ground and use theirtusks to crush hard berries. Crushing berries isalso how they test each other’s strength.
name: Axew

flavor_text: They play with each other by knocking their largetusks together. Their tusks break sometimes, butthey grow back so quickly that it isn’t a concern.
name: Axew

flavor_text: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent.By following the scent, it stalks its targetsand steals from them when they least expect it.
name: Thievul

flavor_text: With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goesaround stealing food and eggs. Boltundis its natural enemy.
name: Thievul

flavor_text: This artificial Pokémon, constructed more than500 years ago, can understand human speechbut cannot itself speak.
name: Magearna

flavor_text: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythmwith its two sticks, the more respect it wins fromits peers.
name: Thwackey

flavor_text: When it’s drumming out rapid beats in battle, itgets so caught up in the rhythm that it won’t evennotice that it’s already knocked out its opponent.
name: Thwackey

flavor_text: They use shells they’ve stolen from Shelmetto arm and protect themselves. They’re verypopular Pokémon in the Galar region.
name: Escavalier

flavor_text: It charges its enemies, lances at the ready.An image of one of its duels is captured in a famouspainting of Escavalier clashing with Sirfetch’d.
name: Escavalier

flavor_text: Its strange physiology reacts to electrical energyin interesting ways. The presence of a Shelmetwill cause this Pokémon to evolve.
name: Karrablast

flavor_text: It spits a liquid from its mouth to melt throughShelmet’s shell. Karrablast doesn’t eat the shell—it eats only the contents.
name: Karrablast

flavor_text: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat,the sound waves produced carry revitalizingenergy to the plants and flowers in the area.
name: Grookey

flavor_text: It attacks with rapid beats of its stick.As it strikes with amazing speed, it getsmore and more pumped.
name: Grookey

flavor_text: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries thatthey fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bitslow-witted, so it doesn’t notice the loss.
name: Greedent

flavor_text: Common throughout the Galar region, thisPokémon has strong teeth and can chewthrough the toughest of berry shells.
name: Greedent

flavor_text: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matterhow powerful. This Pokémon benefits from everybattle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.
name: Rookidee

flavor_text: Jumping nimbly about, this small-bodiedPokémon takes advantage of even the slightestopportunity to disorient larger opponents.
name: Rookidee

flavor_text: This Pokémon is still small and timid.Whenever Magby gets excited or surprised,flames leak from its mouth and its nose.
name: Magby

flavor_text: This Pokémon makes its home near volcanoes.At the end of the day, Magby soaks in magma,resting and recovering from the day’s fatigue.
name: Magby

flavor_text: A warm-up of running around gets fire energycoursing through this Pokémon’s body. Once thathappens, it’s ready to fight at full power.
name: Scorbunny

flavor_text: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, andone on its nose. Once it’s raring to fight, thesepads radiate tremendous heat.
name: Scorbunny

flavor_text: It spins stringnot only from itsrear but also fromits mouth. It ishard to tell whichend is which.
name: Ariados

flavor_text: Palossand is known as the Beach Nightmare. Itpulls its prey down into the sand by controllingthe sand itself, and then it sucks out their souls.
name: Palossand

flavor_text: This Pokémon lives on beaches, but it hateswater. Palossand can’t maintain its castle-likeshape if it gets drenched by a heavy rain.
name: Palossand

flavor_text: They came over from another region longago and worked together with humans.Their green skin is resistant to water.
name: Copperajah

flavor_text: These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks haveincredible grip strength, strong enough to crushgiant rocks into powder.
name: Copperajah

flavor_text: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It’s also verystrong, being able to carry loads of overfive tons without any problem at all.
name: Cufant

flavor_text: If a job requires serious strength, this Pokémonwill excel at it. Its copper body tarnishes in therain, turning a vibrant green color.
name: Cufant

flavor_text: Icy scales fall from its wings like snow as it fliesover fields and mountains. The temperature of itswings is less than −290 degrees Fahrenheit.
name: Frosmoth

flavor_text: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fieldsand mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings,causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.
name: Frosmoth

flavor_text: It spits out thread imbued with a frigid sort ofenergy and uses it to tie its body to branches,disguising itself as an icicle while it sleeps.
name: Snom

flavor_text: It eats snow that piles up on the ground.The more snow it eats, the bigger and moreimpressive the spikes on its back grow.
name: Snom

flavor_text: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape itoff rocks. Electric current flows from the tips ofits spines.
name: Pincurchin

flavor_text: It stores electricity in each spine. Even if one getsbroken off, it still continues to emit electricity forat least three hours.
name: Pincurchin

flavor_text: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass.The brass’s orders are absolute.
name: Falinks

flavor_text: The six of them work together as one Pokémon.Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and theyconstantly change their formation as they fight.
name: Falinks

flavor_text: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-likepouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying itsconstant hunger. It’s also generating electricity.
name: Morpeko

flavor_text: It carries electrically roasted seeds with it as ifthey’re precious treasures. No matter how muchit eats, it always gets hungry again in short order.
name: Morpeko

flavor_text: It uses the horns on its head to sense theemotions of others. Males will act as valets forthose they serve, looking after their every need.
name: Indeedee

flavor_text: Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotionsof creatures around it. Positive emotions are thesource of its strength.
name: Indeedee

flavor_text: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from afrigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly tomake sure it stays nice and cold.
name: Eiscue

flavor_text: This Pokémon keeps its heat-sensitive head coolwith ice. It fishes for its food, dangling its singlehair into the sea to lure in prey.
name: Eiscue

flavor_text: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun’s descentfrom zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talentfor delivering dynamic kicks.
name: Stonjourner

flavor_text: Once a year, on a specific date and at a specifictime, they gather out of nowhere and form up ina circle.
name: Stonjourner

flavor_text: These Pokémon can crush a car with no morethan a headbutt. Bouffalant with more hair ontheir heads hold higher positions within the herd.
name: Bouffalant

flavor_text: These Pokémon live in herds of about 20individuals. Bouffalant that betray the herd willlose the hair on their heads for some reason.
name: Bouffalant

flavor_text: It steals things from people just to amuse itselfwith their frustration. A rivalry exists betweenthis Pokémon and Nickit.
name: Purrloin

flavor_text: Opponents that get drawn in by its adorablebehavior come away with stinging scratches fromits claws and stinging pride from its laughter.
name: Purrloin

flavor_text: These Pokémon seem to enjoy living with humans.Even a Stoutland caught in the wild will warm upto people in about three days.
name: Stoutland

flavor_text: Stoutland is immensely proud of its impressivemoustache. It’s said that moustache length is whatdetermines social standing among this species.
name: Stoutland

flavor_text: If it spies a strong Pokémon, Rufflet can’t resistchallenging it to a battle. But if Rufflet loses,it starts bawling.
name: Rufflet

flavor_text: A combative Pokémon, it’s ready to pick a fightwith anyone. It has talons that can crushhard berries.
name: Rufflet

flavor_text: One swing of the sword incorporated inits armor can fell an opponent. A simpleglare from one of them quiets everybody.
name: Samurott

flavor_text: Strict training is how it learns itsflowing double-scalchop technique.
name: Dewott

flavor_text: It fights using the scalchop on itsstomach. In response to an attack,it retaliates immediately by slashing.
name: Oshawott

flavor_text: It can throw a fire punch by setting itsfists on fire with its fiery chin. It caresdeeply about its friends.
name: Emboar

flavor_text: Herdier is a very smart and friendly Pokémon.So much so that there’s a theory that Herdier wasthe first Pokémon to partner with people.
name: Herdier

flavor_text: The black fur that covers this Pokémon’s bodyis dense and springy. Even sharp fangs bounceright off.
name: Herdier

flavor_text: This Pokémon is courageous but also cautious.It uses the soft fur covering its face to collectinformation about its surroundings.
name: Lillipup

flavor_text: This Pokémon is far brighter than the averagechild, and Lillipup won’t forget the love itreceives or any abuse it suffers.
name: Lillipup

flavor_text: When they see an enemy, their tailsstand high, and they spit the seeds ofberries stored in their cheek pouches.
name: Watchog

flavor_text: Using food stored in cheek pouches,they can keep watch for days. They usetheir tails to communicate with others.
name: Patrat

flavor_text: A very cautiousPOKéMON, it raisesitself up usingits tail to get abetter view of itssurroundings.
name: Sentret

flavor_text: It’s accompanied by a large retinue of Pawniard.Bisharp keeps a keen eye on its minions, ensuringnone of them even think of double-crossing it.
name: Bisharp

flavor_text: Violent conflicts erupt between Bisharp andFraxure over places where sharpening stonescan be found.
name: Bisharp

flavor_text: Its flickering spores lure in prey and put them tosleep. Once this Pokémon has its prey snoozing,it drains their vitality with its fingertips.
name: Shiinotic

flavor_text: If you see a light deep in a forest at night,don’t go near. Shiinotic will make you fallfast asleep.
name: Shiinotic

flavor_text: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquidinside its body. It is one of the organisms knownas UBs.
name: Naganadel

flavor_text: When it bites withits massive andpowerful jaws, itshakes its headand savagely tearsits victim up.
name: Feraligatr

flavor_text: They were sculpted from clay in ancient times.No one knows why, but some of them are drivento continually line up boulders.
name: Golett

flavor_text: This Pokémon was created from clay. It receivedorders from its master many thousands of yearsago, and it still follows those orders to this day.
name: Golett

flavor_text: Artillery platforms built into the walls of ancientcastles served as perches from which Golurkcould fire energy beams.
name: Golurk

flavor_text: There’s a theory that inside Golurk is a perpetualmotion machine that produces limitless energy,but this belief hasn’t been proven.
name: Golurk

flavor_text: Shiny particles are released fromits wings like a veil. It is saidto represent the crescent moon.
name: Cresselia

flavor_text: A Pokémon that lives in warm seas.It inflates the flotation sac on itshead to drift and search for food.
name: Phione

flavor_text: When Mienshao comes across a truly challengingopponent, it will lighten itself by biting off thefur on its arms.
name: Mienshao

flavor_text: Delivered at blinding speeds, kicks from thisPokémon can shatter massive boulders intotiny pieces.
name: Mienshao

flavor_text: Known as “The Being of Willpower.”It sleeps at the bottom of a laketo keep the world in balance.
name: Azelf

flavor_text: It has the power to control time.It appears in Sinnoh-region mythsas an ancient deity.
name: Dialga

flavor_text: Known as “The Being of Knowledge.”It is said that it can wipe out thememory of those who see its eyes.
name: Uxie

flavor_text: Known as “The Being of Emotion.”It taught humans the nobility ofsorrow, pain, and joy.
name: Mesprit

flavor_text: All over the world, there are legends that tellof Regigigas creating other Pokémon in itsown image.
name: Regigigas

flavor_text: It’s said that Regigigas created other Pokémonfrom many different materials before it movedthe continents to where they are today.
name: Regigigas

flavor_text: A Pokémon that is said to live in aworld on the reverse side of ours.It appears in an ancient cemetery.
name: Giratina

flavor_text: It has the ability to distortspace. It is described as a deityin Sinnoh-region mythology.
name: Palkia

flavor_text: It dwells in volcanic caves. Itdigs in with its cross-shaped feetto crawl on ceilings and walls.
name: Heatran

flavor_text: Krokorok has specialized eyes that enable it tosee in the dark. This ability lets Krokorok hunt inthe dead of night without getting lost.
name: Krokorok

flavor_text: Although this Pokémon has specialized eyes thatallow it to see in the dark, Krokorok won’t movemuch at night—the desert gets cold after sunset.
name: Krokorok

flavor_text: At the bidding of transmissions from the spiritworld, it steals people and Pokémon away.No one knows whether it has a will of its own.
name: Dusknoir

flavor_text: With the mouth on its belly, Dusknoir swallows itstarget whole. The soul is the only thing eaten—Dusknoir disgorges the body before departing.
name: Dusknoir

flavor_text: It exudes strong magnetism fromall over. It controls three smallunits called Mini-Noses.
name: Probopass

flavor_text: True to its honorable-warrior image, it usesthe blades on its elbows only in defense ofsomething or someone.
name: Gallade

flavor_text: Sharply attuned to others’ wishes for help, thisPokémon seeks out those in need and aids themin battle.
name: Gallade

flavor_text: Porygon-Z had a program installed to allow it tomove between dimensions, but the program alsocaused instability in Porygon-Z’s behavior.
name: Porygon-Z

flavor_text: Some say an additional program made thisPokémon evolve, but even academics can’t agreeon whether Porygon-Z is really an evolution.
name: Porygon-Z

flavor_text: With cold air that can reach temperatures as lowas −328 degrees Fahrenheit, Regice instantlyfreezes any creature that approaches it.
name: Regice

flavor_text: This Pokémon’s body is made of solid ice. It’ssaid that Regice was born beneath thick ice inthe ice age.
name: Regice

flavor_text: Registeel’s body is made of a strange materialthat is flexible enough to stretch and shrink butalso more durable than any metal.
name: Registeel

flavor_text: It’s rumored that this Pokémon was born deepunderground in the planet’s mantle and that itemerged onto the surface 10,000 years ago.
name: Registeel

flavor_text: Any who become captivated by the beauty ofthe snowfall that Glaceon creates will be frozenbefore they know it.
name: Glaceon

flavor_text: The coldness emanating from Glaceon causespowdery snow to form, making it quite a popularPokémon at ski resorts.
name: Glaceon

flavor_text: Galarians favor the distinctive aroma that driftsfrom this Pokémon’s leaves. There’s a popularperfume made using that scent.
name: Leafeon

flavor_text: This Pokémon’s tail is blade sharp, with afantastic cutting edge that can slice rightthough large trees.
name: Leafeon

flavor_text: From its rear, Beldum emits a magnetic force thatrapidly pulls opponents in. They get skewered onBeldum’s sharp claws.
name: Beldum

flavor_text: The cells in this Pokémon’s body are composedof magnetic material. Instead of blood, magneticforces flow through Beldum’s body.
name: Beldum

flavor_text: Two Beldum have become stuck together viatheir own magnetic forces. With two brains, theresulting Metang has doubled psychic powers.
name: Metang

flavor_text: Using magnetic forces to stay aloft, this Pokémonflies at high speeds, weaving through harshmountain terrain in pursuit of prey.
name: Metang

flavor_text: Because the magnetic powers of these Pokémonget stronger in freezing temperatures, Metagrossliving on snowy mountains are full of energy.
name: Metagross

flavor_text: Metagross is the result of the fusion of twoMetang. This Pokémon defeats its opponentsthrough use of its supercomputer-level brain.
name: Metagross

flavor_text: Every bit of Regirock’s body is made of stone.As parts of its body erode, this Pokémon sticksrocks to itself to repair what’s been lost.
name: Regirock

flavor_text: Cutting-edge technology was used to studythe internals of this Pokémon’s rock body, butnothing was found—not even a brain or a heart.
name: Regirock

flavor_text: LUVDISC live in shallow seas in thetropics. This heart-shaped POKéMONearned its name by swimming afterloving couples it spotted in theocean’s waves.
name: Luvdisc

flavor_text: Bagon jumps off cliffs every day, trying togrow stronger so that someday it will be ableto fly.
name: Bagon

flavor_text: Bagon is a solitary Pokémon that doesn’t formgroups with others of its kind. It also has a headhard enough to cleave a boulder in one strike.
name: Bagon

flavor_text: This Pokémon has covered its body in a hardshell that has the same composition as bone.Shelgon stores energy for evolution.
name: Shelgon

flavor_text: Shelgon ignores its hunger entirely, never eatingany food. Apparently, Shelgon will evolve onceall its energy stores are used up.
name: Shelgon

flavor_text: Salamence is an unusual Pokémon in that itwas able to evolve a body with wings just byconstantly wishing to be able to fly.
name: Salamence

flavor_text: While basking in the joy of flight generally keepsthis Pokémon in high spirits, Salamence turns intoan uncontrollable menace if something angers it.
name: Salamence

flavor_text: Its psychic power can supposedly cover a rangeof more than half a mile—but only if its twobrains can agree with each other.
name: Duosion

flavor_text: Its brain has split into two, and the twohalves rarely think alike. Its actions areutterly unpredictable.
name: Duosion

flavor_text: While it could use its psychic abilities in battle,this Pokémon prefers to swing its powerful armsaround to beat opponents into submission.
name: Reuniclus

flavor_text: It’s said that drinking the liquid surroundingReuniclus grants wisdom. Problem is, the liquid ishighly toxic to anything besides Reuniclus itself.
name: Reuniclus

flavor_text: It has tremendous psychic power, but it dislikesconflict. It’s also able to predict the future basedon the movement of the stars.
name: Gothitelle

flavor_text: A criminal who was shown his fate by a Gothitellewent missing that same day and was neverseen again.
name: Gothitelle

flavor_text: It communicates with others telepathically.Its body is encapsulated in liquid, but if it takesa heavy blow, the liquid will leak out.
name: Solosis

flavor_text: Many say that the special liquid covering thisPokémon’s body would allow it to survive inthe vacuum of space.
name: Solosis

flavor_text: Though they’re still only babies, there’s psychicpower stored in their ribbonlike feelers, andsometimes they use that power to fight.
name: Gothita

flavor_text: Even when nobody seems to be around, Gothitacan still be heard making a muted cry. Many believeit’s speaking to something only it can see.
name: Gothita

flavor_text: It’s said that when stars shine in the night sky,this Pokémon will spirit away sleeping children.Some call it the Witch of Punishment.
name: Gothorita

flavor_text: On nights when the stars shine, this Pokémon’spsychic power is at its strongest. It’s unknown justwhat link Gothorita has to the greater universe.
name: Gothorita

flavor_text: The way it brushes away grime with its tailcan be helpful when cleaning. But its focus onspotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.
name: Minccino

flavor_text: They pet each other with their tails as a form ofgreeting. Of the two, the one whose tail is fluffieris a bit more boastful.
name: Minccino

flavor_text: Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreadsover its nest as a coating to protect it from dust.Cinccino won’t tolerate even a speck of the stuff.
name: Cinccino

flavor_text: A special oil that seeps through their fur helpsthem avoid attacks. The oil fetches a high priceat market.
name: Cinccino

flavor_text: Zorua is a timid Pokémon. This disposition seemsto be what led to the development of Zorua’sability to take on the forms of other creatures.
name: Zorua

flavor_text: Zorua sometimes transforms into a person andgoes into cities to search for food. When Zoruadoes this, it usually takes on the form of a child.
name: Zorua

flavor_text: This Pokémon cares deeply about others of itskind, and it will conjure terrifying illusions tokeep its den and pack safe.
name: Zoroark

flavor_text: Seeking to ease the burden of their solitude,lonely Trainers tell Zoroark to show illusionsto them.
name: Zoroark

flavor_text: They flock in great numbers.Though small, they flap theirwings with great power.
name: Starly

flavor_text: It flies around forests and fieldsin search of bug Pokémon.It stays within a huge flock.
name: Staravia

flavor_text: It lives alone, away from others.Apparently, every one of thembelieves it is the most important.
name: Prinplup

flavor_text: The three horns that extend fromits beak attest to its power. Theleader has the biggest horns.
name: Empoleon

flavor_text: It uses a special kind of martialarts involving all its limbs.Its fire never goes out.
name: Infernape

flavor_text: Because it is very proud, it hatesaccepting food from people. Itsthick down guards it from cold.
name: Piplup

flavor_text: The surface of MARSHTOMP’s body isenveloped by a thin, sticky film thatenables it to live on land.This POKéMON plays in mud on beacheswhen the ocean tide is low.
name: Marshtomp

flavor_text: The fin on MUDKIP’s head acts as highlysensitive radar. Using this fin to sensemovements of water and air, thisPOKéMON can determine what is takingplace around it without using its eyes.
name: Mudkip

flavor_text: In battle, BLAZIKEN blows out intenseflames from its wrists and attacks foescourageously.The stronger the foe, the moreintensely this POKéMON’s wrists burn.
name: Blaziken

flavor_text: COMBUSKEN toughens up its legs andthighs by running through fields andmountains.This POKéMON’s legs possess both speedand power, enabling it to dole out tenkicks in one second.
name: Combusken

flavor_text: TORCHIC sticks with its TRAINER,following behind with unsteadysteps.This POKéMON breathes fire of over1,800 degrees F, including fireballsthat leave the foe scorched black.
name: Torchic

flavor_text: The leaves growing on SCEPTILE’s bodyare very sharp edged. This POKéMON isvery agile - it leaps all over thebranches of trees and jumps on its foefrom above or behind.
name: Sceptile

flavor_text: The leaves growing out of GROVYLE’sbody are convenient for camouflagingit from enemies in the forest.This POKéMON is a master at climbingtrees in jungles.
name: Grovyle

flavor_text: TREECKO has small hooks on the bottomof its feet that enable it to scalevertical walls.This POKéMON attacks by slamming foeswith its thick tail.
name: Treecko

flavor_text: This Pokémon has the ability to move throughtime. Records describing it as a forest deity canbe found from many different eras.
name: Celebi

flavor_text: This Pokémon traveled through time to comefrom the future. It bolsters grass and trees withits own strength, and it can heal wounds, too.
name: Celebi

flavor_text: Legends claim thisPOKéMON flies theworld's skies con­tinuously on itsmagnificent seven-colored wings.
name: Ho-Oh

flavor_text: Thanks to bacteria that lived in the mud flats withit, this Pokémon developed the organs it uses togenerate electricity.
name: Stunfisk

flavor_text: For some reason, this Pokémon smiles slightlywhen it emits a strong electric current from theyellow markings on its body.
name: Stunfisk

flavor_text: Eating a twig fills it with energy,and its roomy ears give vent to airhotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.
name: Fennekin

flavor_text: Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank.It shields its allies from danger with its own body.
name: Chesnaught

flavor_text: It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators’attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.
name: Quilladin

flavor_text: The quills on its head are usually soft.When it flexes them, the points becomeso hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.
name: Chespin

flavor_text: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precisecontrol, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.
name: Frogadier

flavor_text: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back.The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwisetake when attacked.
name: Froakie

flavor_text: It gazes into the flame at the tip ofits branch to achieve a focused state,which allows it to see into the future.
name: Delphox

flavor_text: Its entire body isshielded by asteel-hard shell.What lurks insidethe armor is atotal mystery.
name: Forretress

flavor_text: It excels at digging holes. Using its ears, it candig a nest 33 feet deep in one night.
name: Bunnelby

flavor_text: It’s very sensitive to danger. The sound ofCorviknight’s flapping will have Bunnelbydigging a hole to hide underground in moments.
name: Bunnelby

flavor_text: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water.When it spins them and throws them at high speed,these stars can split metal in two.
name: Greninja

flavor_text: It creates special bouncy balloons to send at itsopponents. When the balloons pop, the sheerforce of their bursting is what deals damage.
name: Popplio

flavor_text: If Popplio want to create big, powerful balloons,they must be persistent. It takes daily practice forthese Pokémon to develop their skills.
name: Popplio

flavor_text: This Pokémon resembles a beautiful flower.A properly raised Lurantis will have gorgeous,brilliant colors.
name: Lurantis

flavor_text: The petals on this Pokémon’s arms are thin andsuper sharp, and they can fire laser beams ifLurantis gathers light first.
name: Lurantis

flavor_text: An academic theory proposes that Regidrago’sarms were once the head of an ancient dragonPokémon. The theory remains unproven.
name: Regidrago

flavor_text: Its body is composed of crystallized dragonenergy. Regidrago is said to have the powers ofevery dragon Pokémon.
name: Regidrago

flavor_text: This Pokémon is a cluster of electrical energy.It’s said that removing the rings on Regieleki’sbody will unleash the Pokémon’s latent power.
name: Regieleki

flavor_text: Its entire body is made up of a single organ thatgenerates electrical energy. Regieleki is capableof creating all Galar’s electricity.
name: Regieleki

flavor_text: When the Kalos region’s ecosystem falls intodisarray, it appears and reveals its secret power.
name: Zygarde

flavor_text: A sudden transformation of Carbink,its pink, glimmering body is said to bethe loveliest sight in the whole world.
name: Diancie

flavor_text: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminatethe sea’s surface from a depth of over three miles.
name: Lanturn

flavor_text: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blindsits prey. This creates an opening for it to deliveran electrical attack.
name: Lanturn

flavor_text: The core on its chest absorbs energy emanatingfrom the lands of the Galar region. This energy iswhat allows Eternatus to stay active.
name: Eternatus

flavor_text: It was inside a meteorite that fell 20,000 yearsago. There seems to be a connection betweenthis Pokémon and the Dynamax phenomenon.
name: Eternatus

flavor_text: Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives in a packwith others of its kind. It’s incredibly aggressive,and the other Pokémon of the forest fear it.
name: Zarude

flavor_text: Once the vines on Zarude’s body tear off, theybecome nutrients in the soil. This helps the plantsof the forest grow.
name: Zarude

flavor_text: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in theone-hit KO. Its strategy is to leap in close to foesand land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.
name: Urshifu

flavor_text: Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, thisPokémon races across sheer cliffs, training its legsand refining its moves.
name: Urshifu

flavor_text: They chill the air around them to −150 degreesFahrenheit, freezing the water in the air into icethat they use as armor.
name: Bergmite

flavor_text: This Pokémon lives in areas of frigid cold.It secures itself to the back of an Avaluggby freezing its feet in place.
name: Bergmite

flavor_text: At high latitudes, this Pokémon can be foundwith clusters of Bergmite on its back as it swimsamong the icebergs.
name: Avalugg

flavor_text: As Avalugg moves about during the day,the cracks in its body deepen. The Pokémon’sbody returns to a pristine state overnight.
name: Avalugg

flavor_text: Spirits that wander this world are placed intoPumpkaboo’s body. They’re then moved on tothe afterlife.
name: Pumpkaboo

flavor_text: The light that streams out from the holes in thepumpkin can hypnotize and control the peopleand Pokémon that see it.
name: Pumpkaboo

flavor_text: Eerie cries emanate from its body in the dead ofnight. The sounds are said to be the wails ofspirits who are suffering in the afterlife.
name: Gourgeist

flavor_text: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeistwill come knocking. Whoever answers the doorwill be swept off to the afterlife.
name: Gourgeist

flavor_text: Legends say it can share eternal life.It slept for a thousand years in the formof a tree before its revival.
name: Xerneas

flavor_text: When this legendary Pokémon’s wings andtail feathers spread wide and glow red,it absorbs the life force of living creatures.
name: Yveltal

flavor_text: After nightfall, they emerge from the caves theynest in during the day. Using their ultrasonicwaves, they go on the hunt for ripened fruit.
name: Noibat

flavor_text: No wavelength of sound is beyond Noibat’sability to produce. The ultrasonic waves itgenerates can overcome much larger Pokémon.
name: Noibat

flavor_text: Aggressive and cruel, this Pokémon will ruthlesslytorment enemies that are helpless in the dark.
name: Noivern

flavor_text: Flying through the darkness, it weakens enemieswith ultrasonic waves that could crush stone.Its fangs finish the fight.
name: Noivern

flavor_text: In one minute, a well-trained Mienfoo can chopwith its arms more than 100 times.
name: Mienfoo

flavor_text: Though small, Mienfoo’s temperament is fierce.Any creature that approaches Mienfoo carelesslywill be greeted with a flurry of graceful attacks.
name: Mienfoo

flavor_text: Its tail has asmall brain of itsown. Beware! Ifyou get close, itmay react to yourscent and bite.
name: Girafarig

flavor_text: The dust-likescales coveringits wings arecolor coded toindicate the kindsof poison it has.
name: Venomoth

flavor_text: Lives in theshadows of talltrees where iteats insects. Itis attracted bylight at night.
name: Venonat

flavor_text: They say that it will appear before kindhearted,caring people and shower them with happiness.
name: Togetic

flavor_text: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people.It can float in midair without moving its wings.
name: Togetic

flavor_text: Cobalion, Terrakion, and Virizion taught thisPokémon how to fight. It dashes across the world,seeking more opportunities to further its training.
name: Keldeo

flavor_text: They say that Keldeo must survive harsh battlesand fully develop the horn on its foreheadbefore this Pokémon’s true power will awaken.
name: Keldeo

flavor_text: It emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to checkits surroundings. Even in tight caves, Zubat fliesaround with skill.
name: Zubat

flavor_text: Zubat live in caves, down where the sun’s lightwon’t reach. In the morning, they gather togetherto keep each other warm as they sleep.
name: Zubat

flavor_text: The more air it takes in, the more it inflates. Ifopponents catch it in a bad mood, it will inflateitself to an enormous size to intimidate them.
name: Wigglytuff

flavor_text: It’s proud of its fur, which is fine and delicate.In particular, the curl on its forehead has atexture that’s perfectly heavenly.
name: Wigglytuff

flavor_text: If exposed to moonlight, it starts to move.It roams far and wide at night to scatter its seeds.
name: Oddish

flavor_text: During the day, it stays in the cold undergroundto avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.
name: Oddish

flavor_text: It loves to drink other creatures’ blood. It’s saidthat if it finds others of its kind going hungry,it sometimes shares the blood it’s gathered.
name: Golbat

flavor_text: Its feet are tiny, but this Pokémon walks skillfully.It sneaks up on sleeping prey before sinking in itsfangs and slurping up blood.
name: Golbat

flavor_text: It has the world’s largest petals. With every step,the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.
name: Vileplume

flavor_text: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen itcontains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.
name: Vileplume

flavor_text: Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor.The horrid stench can cause fainting at a distanceof 1.25 miles.
name: Gloom

flavor_text: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey.It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.
name: Gloom

flavor_text: A host-parasitepair in which theparasite mushroomhas taken over thehost bug. Prefersdamp places.
name: Parasect

flavor_text: Burrows to sucktree roots. Themushrooms on itsback grow by draw­ing nutrients fromthe bug host.
name: Paras

flavor_text: When this Pokémon is in good health, its snotbecomes thicker and stickier. It will smear its snoton anyone it doesn’t like.
name: Cubchoo

flavor_text: It sniffles before performing a move, using itsfrosty snot to provide an icy element to anymove that needs it.
name: Cubchoo

flavor_text: Its resilient tusks are its pride and joy. It licks updirt to take in the minerals it needs to keep itstusks in top condition.
name: Haxorus

flavor_text: While usually kindhearted, it can be terrifying ifangered. Tusks that can slice through steel beamsare how Haxorus deals with its adversaries.
name: Haxorus

flavor_text: The aroma thatrises from itspetals contains asubstance thatcalms aggressivefeelings.
name: Meganium

flavor_text: It is timid, andalways curls it­self up in a ball.If attacked, itflares up its backfor protection.
name: Cyndaquil

flavor_text: Be careful if itturns its backduring battle. Itmeans that it willattack with thefire on its back.
name: Quilava

flavor_text: If its rage peaks,it becomes so hotthat anything thattouches it willinstantly goup in flames.
name: Typhlosion

flavor_text: It was created bya scientist afteryears of horrificgene splicing andDNA engineeringexperiments.
name: Mewtwo

flavor_text: So rare that itis still said tobe a mirage bymany experts. Onlya few people haveseen it worldwide.
name: Mew

flavor_text: A sweet aromagently wafts fromthe leaf on itshead. It is docileand loves to soakup the sun's rays.
name: Chikorita

flavor_text: The scent ofspices comes fromaround its neck.Somehow, sniffingit makes you wantto fight.
name: Bayleef

flavor_text: Its fluffy fur is a delight to pet, but carelesslyreaching out to touch this Pokémon could resultin painful retaliation.
name: Stufful

flavor_text: The way it protects itself by flailing its arms maybe an adorable sight, but stay well away. This isflailing that can snap thick tree trunks.
name: Stufful

flavor_text: Its well-developedjaws are powerfuland capable ofcrushing anything.Even its trainermust be careful.
name: Totodile

flavor_text: If it loses afang, a new onegrows back in itsplace. There arealways 48 fangslining its mouth.
name: Croconaw

flavor_text: Known for its bravery and pride, this majesticPokémon is often seen as a motif for variouskinds of emblems.
name: Braviary

flavor_text: Because this Pokémon is hotheaded andbelligerent, it’s Corviknight that’s takenthe role of transportation in Galar.
name: Braviary

flavor_text: It wears a bone to protect its rear.It often squabbles with others of its kind overparticularly comfy bones.
name: Vullaby

flavor_text: Vullaby grow quickly. Bones that have gotten toosmall for older Vullaby to wear often get passeddown to younger ones in the nest.
name: Vullaby

flavor_text: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to bechosen as a first partner in its own world.
name: Poipole

flavor_text: The first symptom of its sting is numbness.The next is an itching sensation so intense that it’simpossible to resist the urge to claw at your skin.
name: Mareanie

flavor_text: Unlike their Alolan counterparts, the Mareanieof the Galar region have not yet figured outthat the branches of Corsola are delicious.
name: Mareanie

flavor_text: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon,Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabitback when it was alive in prehistoric seas.
name: Dreepy

flavor_text: If this weak Pokémon is by itself, a mere childcould defeat it. But if Dreepy has friends to helpit train, it can evolve and become much stronger.
name: Dreepy

flavor_text: Though it’s able to capture prey by freezing itssurroundings, it has trouble eating the preyafterward because its mouth is on top of its head.
name: Arctovish

flavor_text: The skin on its face is impervious to attack, butbreathing difficulties made this Pokémon goextinct anyway.
name: Arctovish

flavor_text: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to itspowerful lower body, but it went extinct anywayafter it depleted all its plant-based food sources.
name: Dracozolt

flavor_text: The powerful muscles in its tail generate itselectricity. Compared to its lower body,its upper half is entirely too small.
name: Dracozolt

flavor_text: The shaking of its freezing upper half is whatgenerates its electricity. It has a hard timewalking around.
name: Arctozolt

flavor_text: This Pokémon lived on prehistoric seashores andwas able to preserve food with the ice on itsbody. It went extinct because it moved so slowly.
name: Arctozolt

flavor_text: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution.A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring inthe bug Pokémon it preys on.
name: Appletun

flavor_text: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and theskin on its back is especially yummy. Childrenused to have it as a snack.
name: Appletun

flavor_text: As it digs, it swallows sand and stores it in itsneck pouch. The pouch can hold more than17 pounds of sand.
name: Silicobra

flavor_text: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemyis blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.
name: Silicobra

flavor_text: It is a messenger of the skies, carrying smallPokémon and eggs to safety in its bill.
name: Pelipper

flavor_text: Skimming the water’s surface, it dips its large billin the sea, scoops up food and water, andcarries it.
name: Pelipper

flavor_text: It ate a sour apple, and that induced itsevolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acidcapable of causing chemical burns.
name: Flapple

flavor_text: It flies on wings of apple skin and spits apowerful acid. It can also change its shapeinto that of an apple.
name: Flapple

flavor_text: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémoncharges for it straightaway, leading with itssharply pointed jaw. It’s very proud of that jaw.
name: Arrokuda

flavor_text: After it’s eaten its fill, its movements becomeextremely sluggish. That’s when Cramorantswallows it up.
name: Arrokuda

flavor_text: This Pokémon has a jaw that’s as sharp as a spearand as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda’sflesh is surprisingly tasty, too.
name: Barraskewda

flavor_text: It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surgingforward at speeds of over 100 knots beforeramming prey and spearing into them.
name: Barraskewda

flavor_text: When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds ofsand sprays from its nose. If it ever runs out ofsand, it becomes disheartened.
name: Sandaconda

flavor_text: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sandout of its sand sac more efficiently.
name: Sandaconda

flavor_text: It’s so strong that it can knock out someopponents in a single hit, but it also mayforget what it’s battling midfight.
name: Cramorant

flavor_text: This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole.Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries toswallow a Pokémon other than its preferred prey.
name: Cramorant

flavor_text: It stores poison in an internal poison sac andsecretes that poison through its skin. If you touchthis Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.
name: Toxel

flavor_text: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poisonto produce electricity. The voltage is weak, but itcan cause a tingling paralysis.
name: Toxel

flavor_text: When this Pokémon sounds as if it’s strumming aguitar, it’s actually clawing at the protrusions onits chest to generate electricity.
name: Toxtricity

flavor_text: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémonchugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins itmight contain.
name: Toxtricity

flavor_text: It can peck at a rate of 16 times a second todrill holes in trees. It uses the holes for foodstorage and for nesting.
name: Pikipek

flavor_text: It loves helping out with construction projects.It loves it so much that if rain causes work to halt,it swings its log around and throws a tantrum.
name: Timburr

flavor_text: Timburr that have started carrying logs that areabout three times their size are nearly readyto evolve.
name: Timburr

flavor_text: It shows off its muscles to Machoke and otherGurdurr. If it fails to measure up to the otherPokémon, it lies low for a little while.
name: Gurdurr

flavor_text: Gurdurr excels at demolition—construction is notits forte. In any case, there’s skill in the way thisPokémon wields its metal beam.
name: Gurdurr

flavor_text: It mimics everyone it sees, but it puts extraeffort into copying the graceful dance stepsof Mr. Rime as practice.
name: Mime Jr.

flavor_text: It looks for a Mr. Rime that’s a good dancerand carefully copies the Mr. Rime’s stepslike an apprentice.
name: Mime Jr.

flavor_text: It expels both sweat and tears from its eyes.The sweat is a little salty, while the tears havea slight bitterness.
name: Bonsly

flavor_text: This Pokémon lives in dry, rocky areas. As itsgreen spheres dry out, their dull luster increases.
name: Bonsly

flavor_text: It weakens its prey with sound waves intenseenough to cause headaches, then entanglesthem with its sticky tongue.
name: Palpitoad

flavor_text: On occasion, their cries are sublimely pleasing tothe ear. Palpitoad with larger lumps on theirbodies can sing with a wider range of sounds.
name: Palpitoad

flavor_text: The vibrating of the bumps all over its bodycauses earthquake-like tremors. Seismitoad andCroagunk are similar species.
name: Seismitoad

flavor_text: This Pokémon is popular among the elderly,who say the vibrations of its lumps are greatfor massages.
name: Seismitoad

flavor_text: Concrete mixed by Conkeldurr is much moredurable than normal concrete, even when thecompositions of the two materials are the same.
name: Conkeldurr

flavor_text: When going all out, this Pokémon throws asideits concrete pillars and leaps at opponents topummel them with its fists.
name: Conkeldurr

flavor_text: Graceful ripples running across the water’ssurface are a sure sign that Tympole are singingin high-pitched voices below.
name: Tympole

flavor_text: It uses sound waves to communicate withothers of its kind. People and other Pokémonspecies can’t hear its cries of warning.
name: Tympole

flavor_text: It emits cries by agitating an orbat the back of its throat.It moves with flouncing hops.
name: Chingling

flavor_text: It is a brazen brute that bargesits way into another Pokémon’snest and claims it as its own.
name: Purugly

flavor_text: It claws if displeased and purrswhen affectionate. Its ficklenessis very popular among some.
name: Glameow

flavor_text: Becoming active at night, it isknown to swarm with numerousMURKROW in tow.
name: Honchkrow

flavor_text: Some believe it to be a deity that summons rainclouds. When angered, it lets out a warning crythat rings out like the tolling of a bell.
name: Bronzong

flavor_text: Many scientists suspect that this Pokémonoriginated outside the Galar region, based onthe patterns on its body.
name: Bronzong

flavor_text: It appears in ancient ruins. The pattern on itsbody doesn’t come from any culture in theGalar region, so it remains shrouded in mystery.
name: Bronzor

flavor_text: Polishing Bronzor to a shine makes its surfacereflect the truth, according to common lore.Be that as it may, Bronzor hates being polished.
name: Bronzor

flavor_text: In its belly, it reserves stinky fluid that it shootsfrom its tail during battle. As this Pokémon’s dietvaries, so does the stench of its fluid.
name: Skuntank

flavor_text: It digs holes in the ground to make its nest.The stench of the fluid it lets fly from the tipof its tail is extremely potent.
name: Skuntank

flavor_text: From its rear, it sprays a foul-smelling liquid atopponents. It aims for their faces, and it can hitthem from over 16 feet away.
name: Stunky

flavor_text: If it lifts its tail and points its rear at you, beware.It’s about to spray you with a fluid stinky enoughto make you faint.
name: Stunky

flavor_text: It makes its nest on sheer cliffs. Riding the seabreeze, it glides up into the expansive skies.
name: Wingull

flavor_text: It soars on updrafts without flapping its wings.It makes a nest on sheer cliffs at the sea’s edge.
name: Wingull

flavor_text: Known as a legendary hero, this Pokémonabsorbs metal particles, transforming theminto a weapon it uses to battle.
name: Zacian

flavor_text: This Pokémon has slumbered for many years.Some say it’s Zamazenta’s elder sister—otherssay the two Pokémon are rivals.
name: Zacian

flavor_text: The DNA of a space virus underwent asudden mutation upon exposure to alaser beam and resulted in DEOXYS.The crystalline organ on this POKéMON’schest appears to be its brain.
name: Deoxys

flavor_text: In times past, it worked together with a king ofthe people to save the Galar region. It absorbsmetal that it then uses in battle.
name: Zamazenta

flavor_text: This Pokémon slept for aeons while in the form ofa statue. It was asleep for so long, people forgotthat it ever existed.
name: Zamazenta

flavor_text: It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquidmetal within its body is how it generates energy.
name: Meltan

flavor_text: They live as a group, but when the time comes,one strong Meltan will absorb all the othersand evolve.
name: Meltan

flavor_text: This Pokémon is from about 100,000,000years ago. It has the presence of a king, viciousbut magnificent.
name: Tyrantrum

flavor_text: A single bite of Tyrantrum’s massive jaws willdemolish a car. This Pokémon was the king of theancient world.
name: Tyrantrum

flavor_text: This is an ancient Pokémon, revived in moderntimes. It has a violent disposition, and it’ll tearapart anything it gets between its hefty jaws.
name: Tyrunt

flavor_text: This Pokémon is selfish and likes to be pampered.It can also inflict grievous wounds on its Trainerjust by playing around.
name: Tyrunt

flavor_text: A now-vanished desert culture treasured thesePokémon. Appropriately, when Heliolisk came tothe Galar region, treasure came with them.
name: Heliolisk

flavor_text: One Heliolisk basking in the sun with its frilloutspread is all it would take to produce enoughelectricity to power a city.
name: Heliolisk

flavor_text: When spread, the frills on its head act like solarpanels, generating the power behind thisPokémon’s electric moves.
name: Helioptile

flavor_text: The sun powers this Pokémon’s electricitygeneration. Interruption of that processstresses Helioptile to the point of weakness.
name: Helioptile

flavor_text: After using the feelers on its oversized claw todetect the location of prey, Clawitzer launchesa cannonball of water at its target.
name: Clawitzer

flavor_text: Clawitzer’s right arm is a cannon that launchesprojectiles made of seawater. Shots from aClawitzer’s cannon arm can sink a tanker.
name: Clawitzer

flavor_text: Clauncher’s claws can fall off during battle, butthey’ll regenerate. The meat inside the claws ispopular as a delicacy in Galar.
name: Clauncher

flavor_text: By detonating gas that accumulates in its rightclaw, this Pokémon launches water like a bullet.This is how Clauncher defeats its enemies.
name: Clauncher

flavor_text: Dragalge uses a poisonous liquid capable ofcorroding metal to send tankers that enter itsterritory to the bottom of the sea.
name: Dragalge

flavor_text: Dragalge generates dragon energy by stickingthe plume on its head out above the ocean’ssurface and bathing it in sunlight.
name: Dragalge

flavor_text: It drifts in the ocean, blending in with floatingseaweed. When other Pokémon come to feast onthe seaweed, Skrelp feasts on them instead.
name: Skrelp

flavor_text: Skrelp looks like a piece of rotten seaweed, so itcan blend in with seaweed drifting on the oceanand avoid being detected by enemies.
name: Skrelp

flavor_text: Aurorus was restored from a fossil. It’s said thatwhen this Pokémon howls, auroras appear in thenight sky.
name: Aurorus

flavor_text: When gripped by rage, Aurorus will emanatefreezing air, covering everything around it in ice.
name: Aurorus

flavor_text: This Pokémon was successfully restored from afossil. In the past, it lived with others of its kindin cold lands where there were fewer predators.
name: Amaura

flavor_text: Amaura is an ancient Pokémon that has goneextinct. Specimens of this species can sometimesbe found frozen in ice.
name: Amaura

flavor_text: All the SPINDA that exist in theworld are said to have utterly uniquespot patterns.The shaky, tottering steps of thisPOKéMON give it the appearance ofdancing.
name: Spinda

flavor_text: GRUMPIG uses the black pearls on itsbody to amplify its psychic power wavesfor gaining total control over its foe.When this POKéMON uses its specialpower, its snorting breath growslabored.
name: Grumpig

flavor_text: SPOINK bounces around on its tail.The shock of its bouncing makes itsheart pump. As a result, this POKéMONcannot afford to stop bouncing - if itstops, its heart will stop.
name: Spoink

flavor_text: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blowsout black soot if it is endangered.
name: Torkoal

flavor_text: You find abandoned coal mines full of them.They dig tirelessly in search of coal.
name: Torkoal

flavor_text: VIGOROTH is always itching and agitatedto go on a wild rampage. It simply can’ttolerate sitting still for even a minute.This POKéMON’s stress level rises if itcan’t be moving constantly.
name: Vigoroth

flavor_text: SLAKING spends all day lying down andlolling about.It eats grass growing within its reach.If it eats all the grass it can reach,this POKéMON reluctantly moves toanother spot.
name: Slaking

flavor_text: It can sometimes knock out opponentswith the shock created by breaching andcrashing its big body onto the water.
name: Wailord

flavor_text: Its immense size is the reason for its popularity.Wailord watching is a favorite sightseeingactivity in various parts of the world.
name: Wailord

flavor_text: It shows off by spraying jets of seawater fromthe nostrils above its eyes. It eats a solid ton ofWishiwashi every day.
name: Wailmer

flavor_text: When it sucks in a large volume of seawater,it becomes like a big, bouncy ball. It eats a tonof food daily.
name: Wailmer

flavor_text: MASQUERAIN intimidates enemies withthe eyelike patterns on its antennas.This POKéMON flaps its four wings tofreely fly in any direction - evensideways and backwards - as if it werea helicopter.
name: Masquerain

flavor_text: SHROOMISH live in damp soil in the darkdepths of forests. They are oftenfound keeping still under fallen leaves.This POKéMON feeds on compost thatis made up of fallen, rotted leaves.
name: Shroomish

flavor_text: BRELOOM closes in on its foe with lightand sprightly footwork, then throwspunches with its stretchy arms.This POKéMON’s fighting technique putsboxers to shame.
name: Breloom

flavor_text: SLAKOTH lolls around for over twentyhours every day. Because it moves solittle, it does not need much food.This POKéMON’s sole daily meal consistsof just three leaves.
name: Slakoth

flavor_text: It is highly attuned to the emotions of peopleand Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.
name: Ralts

flavor_text: If its horns capture the warm feelings of peopleor Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.
name: Ralts

flavor_text: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows withenergy, dancing joyously while spinning about.
name: Kirlia

flavor_text: It has a psychic power that enables it to distortthe space around it and see into the future.
name: Kirlia

flavor_text: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing itstwo wings together cause severe headaches.
name: Vibrava

flavor_text: To help make its wings grow, it dissolvesquantities of prey in its digestive juices andguzzles them down every day.
name: Vibrava

flavor_text: From the tips of its feet, SURSKITsecretes an oil that enables it to walkon water as if it were skating.This POKéMON feeds on microscopicorganisms in ponds and lakes.
name: Surskit

flavor_text: It drives its opponents to exhaustion with its agilemaneuvers, then ends the fight with a flashyfinishing move.
name: Hawlucha

flavor_text: It always strikes a pose before going for itsfinishing move. Sometimes opponents takeadvantage of that time to counterattack.
name: Hawlucha

flavor_text: It controls waves known as auras, which arepowerful enough to pulverize huge rocks.It uses these waves to take down its prey.
name: Lucario

flavor_text: It can tell what people are thinking. Only Trainerswho have justice in their hearts can earn thisPokémon’s trust.
name: Lucario

flavor_text: It moves through the sands with its mouth open,swallowing sand along with its prey. It gets rid ofthe sand by spouting it from its nose.
name: Hippopotas

flavor_text: This Pokémon is active during the day and passesthe cold desert nights burrowed snugly intothe sand.
name: Hippopotas

flavor_text: Stuffing itself with vast amounts of food is itsonly concern. Whether the food is rotten orfresh, yummy or tasteless—it does not care.
name: Munchlax

flavor_text: It stores food beneath its fur. It might sharejust one bite, but only if it really trusts you.
name: Munchlax

flavor_text: It’s exceedingly energetic, with enough staminato keep running all through the night. Taking itfor walks can be a challenging experience.
name: Riolu

flavor_text: It can use waves called auras to gauge howothers are feeling. These same waves can also tellthis Pokémon about the state of the environment.
name: Riolu

flavor_text: This Pokémon emits ultrasonic waves from aprotrusion on either side of its head to probepitch-dark caves.
name: Gabite

flavor_text: Jewels are buried in the caves these Pokémonnest in, but you’ll be torn apart by claws andfangs the moment you enter one of these caves.
name: Gabite

flavor_text: Garchomp makes its home in volcanic mountains.It flies through the sky as fast as a jet airplane,hunting down as much prey as it can.
name: Garchomp

flavor_text: Garchomp is fast both underground and above.It can bring down prey and return to its denbefore its body has chilled from being outside.
name: Garchomp

flavor_text: Exactly 108 spirits gathered to become thisPokémon. Apparently there are some ill-naturedspirits in the mix.
name: Spiritomb

flavor_text: All Spiritomb’s mischief and misdeeds compelleda traveler to use a mysterious spell to bindSpiritomb to an odd keystone.
name: Spiritomb

flavor_text: Gible prefers to stay in narrow holes in the sidesof caves heated by geothermal energy. This way,Gible can stay warm even during a blizzard.
name: Gible

flavor_text: Gible attacks anything that moves, and it dragswhatever it catches into the crevice that is its lair.Despite the big mouth, Gible’s stomach is small.
name: Gible

flavor_text: Mimicking Chansey, Happiny will place an egg-shaped stone in its belly pouch. Happiny willtreasure this stone.
name: Happiny

flavor_text: Happiny’s willing to lend its precious round stoneto those it’s friendly with, but if the stone isn’treturned, Happiny will cry and throw a tantrum.
name: Happiny

flavor_text: It can learn and speak humanwords. If they gather, they alllearn the same saying.
name: Chatot

flavor_text: SILCOON tethers itself to a tree branchusing silk to keep from falling. There, this POKéMON hangs quietly while itawaits evolution.It peers out of the silk cocoon througha small hole.
name: Silcoon

flavor_text: BEAUTIFLY’s favorite food is the sweetpollen of flowers. If you want to seethis POKéMON, just leave a pottedflower by an open window. BEAUTIFLYis sure to come looking for pollen.
name: Beautifly

flavor_text: Its fur is strong and supple. Shaving brushesmade with shed Linoone hairs are highly prized.
name: Linoone

flavor_text: It uses its explosive speed and razor-sharp clawsto bring down prey. Running along windingpaths is not its strong suit.
name: Linoone

flavor_text: Using the spikes on its rear end,  WURMPLE peels the bark off trees andfeeds on the sap that oozes out.This POKéMON’s feet are tipped withsuction pads that allow it to cling toglass without slipping.
name: Wurmple

flavor_text: Thickly coveredwith a filthy,vile sludge. Itis so toxic, evenits footprintscontain poison.
name: Muk

flavor_text: Appears in filthyareas. Thrives bysucking uppolluted sludgethat is pumpedout of factories.
name: Grimer

flavor_text: Its body is full of poisonous gas. It floats intogarbage dumps, seeking out the fumes of raw,rotting trash.
name: Koffing

flavor_text: It adores polluted air. Some claim that Koffingused to be more plentiful in the Galar regionthan they are now.
name: Koffing

flavor_text: If this Pokémon’s sticky saliva gets on you andyou don’t clean it off, an intense itch will set in.The itch won’t go away, either.
name: Lickitung

flavor_text: Bug Pokémon are Lickitung’s main food source.This Pokémon paralyzes its prey with a lick fromits long tongue, then swallows the prey whole.
name: Lickitung

flavor_text: Uses its threebrains to executecomplex plans.While two headssleep, one headstays awake.
name: Dodrio

flavor_text: A bird that makesup for its poorflying with itsfast foot speed.Leaves giantfootprints.
name: Doduo

flavor_text: Stores thermalenergy in itsbody. Swims at asteady 8 knotseven in intenselycold waters.
name: Dewgong

flavor_text: The protrudinghorn on its headis very hard.It is used forbashing throughthick ice.
name: Seel

flavor_text: At times, Magnemite runs out of electricity andends up on the ground. If you give batteries to agrounded Magnemite, it’ll start moving again.
name: Magnemite

flavor_text: It subsists on electricity. As Magnemite flies, itemits electromagnetic waves from the units oneach side of its body.
name: Magnemite

flavor_text: Slowpoke became Slowbro when a Shellder biton to its tail. Sweet flavors seeping from the tailmake the Shellder feel as if its life is a dream.
name: Slowbro

flavor_text: Being bitten by a Shellder shocked this Pokémoninto standing on two legs. If the Shellder lets go,it seems Slowbro will turn back into a Slowpoke.
name: Slowbro

flavor_text: The stalk this Pokémon carries in its wings servesas a sword to cut down opponents. In a diresituation, the stalk can also serve as food.
name: Farfetch’d

flavor_text: They use a plant stalk as a weapon, but not allof them use it in the same way. Several distinctstyles of stalk fighting have been observed.
name: Farfetch’d

flavor_text: This Pokémon is three Magnemite that havelinked together. Magneton sends out powerfulradio waves to study its surroundings.
name: Magneton

flavor_text: This Pokémon is constantly putting out a powerfulmagnetic force. Most computers go haywire whena Magneton approaches.
name: Magneton

flavor_text: CASTFORM’s appearance changes withthe weather.This POKéMON gained the ability to usethe vast power of nature to protectits tiny body.
name: Castform

flavor_text: It draws out and controls the hidden powerof flowers. The flower Flabébé holdsis most likely part of its body.
name: Flabébé

flavor_text: Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists.It has even been referred to as the mostbeautiful Pokémon of all.
name: Milotic

flavor_text: It’s said that a glimpse of a Milotic and its beautywill calm any hostile emotions you’re feeling.
name: Milotic

flavor_text: Feared and loathedby many, it isbelieved to bringmisfortune to allthose who see itat night.
name: Murkrow

flavor_text: Miraculously, this former Slowpoke’s latentintelligence was drawn out when Shellder poisonraced through its brain.
name: Slowking

flavor_text: Slowking can solve any problem presented to it,but no one can understand a thing Slowking says.
name: Slowking

flavor_text: When faced with a larger opponent, it swallowsas much water as it can to match theopponent’s size.
name: Qwilfish

flavor_text: The small spikes covering its body developedfrom scales. They inject a toxin that causes fainting.
name: Qwilfish

flavor_text: It is actuallytimid and easilyspooked. If at­tacked, it flailsabout to fend offits attacker.
name: Granbull

flavor_text: Although it is agood climber, itprefers to snaptrees with itsforelegs and eatfallen BERRIES.
name: Ursaring

flavor_text: If it finds honey,its crescent markglows. It alwayslicks its pawsbecause they aresoaked with honey.
name: Teddiursa

flavor_text: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, itsuddenly extends the claws and startlesits enemy.
name: Sneasel

flavor_text: It has a cunning yet savage disposition.It waits for parents to leave their nests,and then it sneaks in to steal their eggs.
name: Sneasel

flavor_text: Heracross loves sweet sap and will go lookingthrough forests for it. The Pokémon uses its twoantennae to pick up scents as it searches.
name: Heracross

flavor_text: This Pokémon takes pride in its strength, whichallows it to lift things 100 times heavier thanitself with no trouble at all.
name: Heracross

flavor_text: Its tail is sopowerful that itcan use it to graba tree branch andhold itself up inthe air.
name: Aipom

flavor_text: It may drop out ofthe sky suddenly.If attacked by aSPEAROW, it willviolently shakeits leaves.
name: Sunkern

flavor_text: It converts sun­light into energy.In the darknessafter sunset, itcloses its petalsand becomes still.
name: Sunflora

flavor_text: If it flaps itswings really fast,it can generateshock waves thatwill shatter win­dows in the area.
name: Yanma

flavor_text: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave thewater to search for food when it gets cold outside.
name: Wooper

flavor_text: When walking on land, it covers its body with apoisonous film that keeps its skin from dehydrating.
name: Wooper

flavor_text: It has an easygoing nature. It doesn’t care if itbumps its head on boats and boulderswhile swimming.
name: Quagsire

flavor_text: Its body is always slimy. It often bangs its headon the river bottom as it swims but seems notto care.
name: Quagsire

flavor_text: By reading air currents, it can predict things suchas the weather or its foe’s next move.
name: Espeon

flavor_text: It unleashes psychic power from the orb on itsforehead. When its power is exhausted, the orbgrows dull and dark.
name: Espeon

flavor_text: When this Pokémon becomes angry, its poressecrete a poisonous sweat, which it sprays atits opponent’s eyes.
name: Umbreon

flavor_text: On the night of a full moon, or when it getsexcited, the ring patterns on its body glow yellow.
name: Umbreon

flavor_text: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear apower-save belt to be able to regulateits motions.
name: Machoke

flavor_text: Its formidable body never gets tired. It helpspeople by doing work such as the moving ofheavy goods.
name: Machoke

flavor_text: Swift as the wind, Absol races through fields andmountains. Its curved, bow-like horn is acutelysensitive to the warning signs of natural disasters.
name: Absol

flavor_text: Because of this Pokémon’s ability to detectdanger, people mistook Absol as a bringerof doom.
name: Absol

flavor_text: Pokémon living in the forest eat thedelicious caps on Morelull’s head.The caps regrow overnight.
name: Morelull

flavor_text: Morelull live in forests that stay dark evenduring the day. They scatter flickering sporesthat put enemies to sleep.
name: Morelull

flavor_text: Its whole body is composed of muscles.Even though it’s the size of a human child, it canhurl 100 grown-ups.
name: Machop

flavor_text: Always brimming with power, it passes time bylifting boulders. Doing so makes it even stronger.
name: Machop

flavor_text: One of the dangerous Ultra Beasts, it has beenspotted running across the land atterrific speeds.
name: Pheromosa

flavor_text: It has an incredibly high level of intelligence.Some say that Alakazam remembers everythingthat ever happens to it, from birth till death.
name: Alakazam

flavor_text: Alakazam wields potent psychic powers. It’s saidthat this Pokémon used these powers to createthe spoons it holds.
name: Alakazam

flavor_text: A common sight inforests and woods.It flaps itswings at groundlevel to kick upblinding sand.
name: Pidgey

flavor_text: Very protectiveof its sprawlingterritorial area,this POKéMON willfiercely peck atany intruder.
name: Pidgeotto

flavor_text: Almost incapableof moving, thisPOKéMON can onlyharden its shellto protect itselffrom predators.
name: Kakuna

flavor_text: Flies at highspeed and attacksusing its largevenomous stingerson its forelegsand tail.
name: Beedrill

flavor_text: In battle, it flaps its wings at great speed torelease highly toxic dust into the air.
name: Butterfree

flavor_text: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey ontothe hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.
name: Butterfree

flavor_text: Often found inforests, eatingleaves.It has a sharpvenomous stingeron its head.
name: Weedle

flavor_text: For protection, it releases a horrible stench fromthe antenna on its head to drive away enemies.
name: Caterpie

flavor_text: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads thatenable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.
name: Caterpie

flavor_text: It is waiting for the moment to evolve. At thisstage, it can only harden, so it remainsmotionless to avoid attack.
name: Metapod

flavor_text: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell,the body inside is tender. It can’t withstand aharsh attack.
name: Metapod

flavor_text: This Pokémon uses its psychic powers while itsleeps. The contents of Abra’s dreams affect thepowers that the Pokémon wields.
name: Abra

flavor_text: Abra can teleport in its sleep. Apparentlythe more deeply Abra sleeps, the farther itsteleportations go.
name: Abra

flavor_text: By drinking pure water, it grows its icy body.This Pokémon can be hard to find on days withwarm, sunny weather.
name: Vanillish

flavor_text: It blasts enemies with cold air reaching −148degrees Fahrenheit, freezing them solid. But itspares their lives afterward—it’s a kind Pokémon.
name: Vanillish

flavor_text: This Ultra Beast came from the Ultra Wormhole.It seems not to attack enemies on its own, butits sharp body is a dangerous weapon in itself.
name: Kartana

flavor_text: When hunting, itskims the surfaceof water at highspeed to pick offunwary prey suchas MAGIKARP.
name: Pidgeot

flavor_text: Bites anythingwhen it attacks.Small and veryquick, it is acommon sight inmany places.
name: Rattata

flavor_text: This Pokémon brings victory. It is saidthat Trainers with Victini always win,regardless of the type of encounter.
name: Victini

flavor_text: Staring at the swirl on its belly causes drowsiness.This trait of Poliwhirl’s has been used in place oflullabies to get children to go to sleep.
name: Poliwhirl

flavor_text: This Pokémon’s sweat is a slimy mucus. Whencaptured, Poliwhirl can slither from its enemies’grasp and escape.
name: Poliwhirl

flavor_text: For Poliwag, swimming is easier than walking.The swirl pattern on its belly is actually part ofthe Pokémon’s innards showing through the skin.
name: Poliwag

flavor_text: In rivers with fast-flowing water, this Pokémon willcling to a rock by using its thick lips, which actlike a suction cup.
name: Poliwag

flavor_text: By slipping into the shadow of a martial artsmaster and copying their movements, thisPokémon learned the ultimate techniques.
name: Marshadow

flavor_text: This Pokémon can conceal itself in any shadow,so it went undiscovered for a long time.
name: Marshadow

flavor_text: Unable to survive in hot areas, it makes itselfcomfortable by breathing out air cold enough tocause snow. It burrows into the snow to sleep.
name: Vanillite

flavor_text: Supposedly, this Pokémon was born from anicicle. It spews out freezing air at −58 degreesFahrenheit to make itself more comfortable.
name: Vanillite

flavor_text: This Pokémon puffs poisonous spores at its foes.If the spores aren’t washed off quickly, they’llgrow into mushrooms wherever they land.
name: Amoonguss
