flavor_text: Amoonguss generally doesn’t move much. Ittends to stand still near Poké Balls that havebeen dropped on the ground.
name: Amoonguss

flavor_text: It beats its wings together to create fire.As it moves in the steps of its beautiful dance,it bathes opponents in intense flames.
name: Oricorio

flavor_text: It makes its nest by dammingstreams with bark and mud. It isknown as an industrious worker.
name: Bibarel

flavor_text: It shakes its head back to front,causing its antennae to hit eachother and sound like a xylophone.
name: Kricketot

flavor_text: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémonbecomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completelyempty of berries.
name: Skwovet

flavor_text: It eats berries nonstop—a habit that has madeit more resilient than it looks. It’ll show up onfarms, searching for yet more berries.
name: Skwovet

flavor_text: After captivating opponents with its sweet scent,it lashes them with its thorny whips.
name: Roserade

flavor_text: The poison in its right hand is quick acting.The poison in its left hand is slow acting.Both are life threatening.
name: Roserade

flavor_text: This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks,and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorbthe nutrients it finds within the stone.
name: Ferrothorn

flavor_text: Its spikes are harder than steel. This Pokémoncrawls across rock walls by stabbing the spikeson its feelers into the stone.
name: Ferrothorn

flavor_text: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hidesfrom its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, bypretending it’s just an apple and nothing more.
name: Applin

flavor_text: As soon as it’s born, it burrows into an apple. Notonly does the apple serve as its food source, butthe flavor of the fruit determines its evolution.
name: Applin

flavor_text: The two minigears that compose this Pokémonare closer than twins. They mesh well only witheach other.
name: Klink

flavor_text: It’s suspected that Klink were the inspirationbehind ancient people’s invention of thefirst gears.
name: Klink

flavor_text: It survives by absorbing light. After a long timespent slumbering underground, impuritiesaccumulated within it, causing its body to darken.
name: Necrozma

flavor_text: It needs light to survive, and it goes on arampage seeking it out. Its laser beams willcut anything to pieces.
name: Necrozma

flavor_text: Its thick and fluffy fur protects it from the coldand enables it to use hotter fire moves.
name: Raboot

flavor_text: It kicks berries right off the branches of treesand then juggles them with its feet, practicingits footwork.
name: Raboot

flavor_text: This Lycanroc is calm and cautious. The rocksjutting from its mane are razor sharp.
name: Lycanroc

flavor_text: With swift movements, this Pokémon graduallybacks its prey into a corner. Lycanroc’s fangs arealways aimed toward opponents’ weak spots.
name: Lycanroc

flavor_text: It lived in jungles around 100million years ago. Its skull is ashard as iron.
name: Cranidos

flavor_text: When its internal fire flares up, itsmovements grow sharper and faster.When in trouble, it emits smoke.
name: Pignite

flavor_text: It can deftly dodge its foe’s attackswhile shooting fireballs from its nose.It roasts berries before it eats them.
name: Tepig

flavor_text: It tends to move in a pack. Individuals squashagainst one another to toughen their spirits.
name: Wynaut

flavor_text: It tends to move in a pack with others.They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.
name: Wynaut

flavor_text: It can lull people to sleep andmake them dream. It is activeduring nights of the new moon.
name: Darkrai

flavor_text: Born on a cold seafloor, itwill swim great distances toreturn to its birthplace.
name: Manaphy

flavor_text: It is described in mythology asthe Pokémon that shaped theuniverse with its 1,000 arms.
name: Arceus

flavor_text: It lives in flower patches andavoids detection by curling upto look like a flowering plant.
name: Shaymin

flavor_text: It is very intelligent and calm.Being exposed to lots of sunlight makesits movements swifter.
name: Snivy

flavor_text: SWELLOW flies high above our heads,making graceful arcs in the sky.This POKéMON dives at a steep angle assoon as it spots its prey. The haplessprey is tightly grasped by SWELLOW’sclawed feet, preventing escape.
name: Swellow

flavor_text: It can stop its opponents’movements with just a glare. It takesin solar energy and boosts it internally.
name: Serperior

flavor_text: It moves along the ground as if sliding.Its swift movements befuddle its foes,and it then attacks with a vine whip.
name: Servine

flavor_text: Known as the Beast That Calls the Moon, thisPokémon lives by taking in any and all light andconverting it into its own energy.
name: Lunala

flavor_text: It steals the light from its surroundings and thenbecomes the full moon, showering its own lightacross the night sky.
name: Lunala

flavor_text: One of several mysterious Ultra Beasts. Peopleon the street report observing those infestedby it suddenly becoming violent.
name: Nihilego

flavor_text: The absorption of starlight fuels this Pokémon’sgrowth. The shell that encases it is harder thanany known material.
name: Cosmoem

flavor_text: It sucks in dust from the air at an astounding rate,frantically building up energy within its core aspreparation for evolution.
name: Cosmoem

flavor_text: TAILLOW courageously stands itsground against foes, however strongthey may be.This gutsy POKéMON will remain defianteven after a loss. On the other hand,it cries loudly if it becomes hungry.
name: Taillow

flavor_text: One of the mysterious life-forms known as UltraBeasts. Astonishing electric shocks emanatefrom its entire body, according to witnesses.
name: Xurkitree

flavor_text: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. Witnessesobserved it flying across the sky at high speed.
name: Celesteela

flavor_text: This Ultra Beast appeared from another world.It shows off its body, but whether that displayis a boast or a threat remains unclear.
name: Buzzwole

flavor_text: This Pokémon can bond very strongly with itsTrainer, but it also has a habit of biting. Raisinga Rockruff for a long time can be challenging.
name: Rockruff

flavor_text: This Pokémon intimidates opponents by strikingthe ground with the rocks on its neck. Themoment an opponent flinches, Rockruff attacks.
name: Rockruff

flavor_text: It launches water bubbles with its legs, drowningprey within the bubbles. This Pokémon can thentake its time to savor its meal.
name: Araquanid

flavor_text: It acts as a caretaker for Dewpider, putting theminside its bubble and letting them eat anyleftover food.
name: Araquanid

flavor_text: It has gobbled mountains and swallowed wholebuildings, according to reports. It’s one of theUltra Beasts.
name: Guzzlord

flavor_text: It crosses its knifelike arms infront of its chest when it cries.It can compose melodies ad lib.
name: Kricketune

flavor_text: This Pokémon generates electricity by contractingits muscles. Excited trembling is a sign that Shinxis generating a tremendous amount of electricity.
name: Shinx

flavor_text: Electricity makes this Pokémon’s fur glow. Shinxsends signals to others of its kind by shaking thetip of its tail while the tail tip is shining brightly.
name: Shinx

flavor_text: Rock-hard scales and oil-filled swim bladdersallow this Pokémon to survive the intense waterpressure of the deep sea.
name: Relicanth

flavor_text: This Pokémon was discovered during deep-seaexploration. Its appearance hasn’t changed in100,000,000 years, so it’s called a living fossil.
name: Relicanth

flavor_text: GOREBYSS lives in the southern seasat extreme depths. Its body is built towithstand the enormous pressure ofwater at incredible depths. Because ofthis, this POKéMON’s body is unharmedby ordinary attacks.
name: Gorebyss

flavor_text: The pollen it releases contains poison. If thisPokémon is raised on clean water, the poison’stoxicity is increased.
name: Budew

flavor_text: This Pokémon is highly sensitive to temperaturechanges. When its bud starts to open, that meansspring is right around the corner.
name: Budew

flavor_text: If it remains still, it looks just like a real nut.It delights in surprising foraging Pokémon.
name: Seedot

flavor_text: It attaches itself to a tree branch using the top ofits head. Strong winds can sometimes make it fall.
name: Seedot

flavor_text: By joining its tail with that of another Luxio, thisPokémon can receive some of the other Luxio’selectricity and power up its own electric blasts.
name: Luxio

flavor_text: Upon encountering an opponent, this Pokémonprepares for battle by extending its claws, whichcan put out 1,000,000 volts of electricity.
name: Luxio

flavor_text: Luxray can see through solid objects. It willinstantly spot prey trying to hide behind walls,even if the walls are thick.
name: Luxray

flavor_text: Seeing through solid objects uses up a lot ofLuxray’s electricity, so the Pokémon sleeps forlong periods of time to store up energy.
name: Luxray

flavor_text: This Pokémon’s body is covered in blubber andimpressively round. It’s faster for Spheal to rollaround than walk.
name: Spheal

flavor_text: As it drifts among the waves, Spheal probesthe sea. As soon as it spots prey, it informs theWalrein in its herd.
name: Spheal

flavor_text: It has a body of ice that won’t melt, even withfire. It can instantly freeze moisture inthe atmosphere.
name: Glalie

flavor_text: It can instantly freeze moisture in theatmosphere. It uses this power to freeze its foes.
name: Glalie

flavor_text: It’s said that if they are seen at midnight, they’llcause heavy snow. They eat snow and iceto survive.
name: Snorunt

flavor_text: It can only survive in cold areas. It bounceshappily around, even in environments as cold as−150 degrees Fahrenheit.
name: Snorunt

flavor_text: The rhythm of bright, festive music activatesLudicolo’s cells, making it more powerful.
name: Ludicolo

flavor_text: If it hears festive music, it begins moving inrhythm in order to amplify its power.
name: Ludicolo

flavor_text: HUNTAIL’s presence went unnoticed bypeople for a long time because it livesat extreme depths in the sea.This POKéMON’s eyes can see clearlyeven in the murky dark depths of theocean.
name: Huntail

flavor_text: CLAMPERL’s sturdy shell is not only goodfor protection - it is also used forclamping and catching prey.A fully grown CLAMPERL’s shell will bescored with nicks and scratches allover.
name: Clamperl

flavor_text: Walrein form herds of 20 to 30 individuals.When a threat appears, the herd’s leader willprotect the group with its life.
name: Walrein

flavor_text: Walrein’s tusks keep growing throughout its life.Tusks broken in battle will grow back to theirusual impressive size in a year.
name: Walrein

flavor_text: Sealeo live on top of drift ice. They go swimmingwhen they’re on the hunt, seeking out their preyby scent.
name: Sealeo

flavor_text: This Pokémon has a habit of spinning roundthings on its nose, whether those things arePoké Balls or Spheal.
name: Sealeo

flavor_text: Despite its small size, it can zap even adulthumans. However, if it does so, it alsosurprises itself.
name: Pichu

flavor_text: The electric sacs in its cheeks are small. If even alittle electricity leaks, it becomes shocked.
name: Pichu

flavor_text: This Pokémon eats trash, which turns into poisoninside its body. The main component of thepoison depends on what sort of trash was eaten.
name: Garbodor

flavor_text: The toxic liquid it launches from its right armis so virulent that it can kill a weakenedcreature instantly.
name: Garbodor

flavor_text: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If youleave trash lying around, you could even findone of these Pokémon living in your room.
name: Trubbish

flavor_text: This Pokémon was born from a bag stuffed withtrash. Galarian Weezing relish the fumes belchedby Trubbish.
name: Trubbish

flavor_text: According to local rumors, Cleffa are often seenin places where shooting stars have fallen.
name: Cleffa

flavor_text: Because of its unusual, starlike silhouette, peoplebelieve that it came here on a meteor.
name: Cleffa

flavor_text: Carracosta completely devours its prey—bones,shells, and all. Because of this, Carracosta’s ownshell grows thick and sturdy.
name: Carracosta

flavor_text: This Pokémon emerges from the water in searchof prey despite the fact that it moves moreslowly on land.
name: Carracosta

flavor_text: This Pokémon inhabited ancient seas. Althoughit can only crawl, it still comes up onto land insearch of prey.
name: Tirtouga

flavor_text: Tirtouga is considered to be the ancestor ofmany turtle Pokémon. It was restored to lifefrom a fossil.
name: Tirtouga

flavor_text: It needs a running start to take off. If Archeopswants to fly, it first needs to run nearly 25 mph,building speed over a course of about 2.5 miles.
name: Archeops

flavor_text: Though capable of flight, Archeops wasapparently better at hunting on the ground.
name: Archeops

flavor_text: This Pokémon was successfully restored from afossil. As research suggested, Archen is unableto fly. But it’s very good at jumping.
name: Archen

flavor_text: Archen is said to be the ancestor of birdPokémon. It lived in treetops, eating berriesand bug Pokémon.
name: Archen

flavor_text: Psychic power allows these Pokémon to fly. Somesay they were the guardians of an ancient city.Others say they were the guardians’ emissaries.
name: Sigilyph

flavor_text: A discovery was made in the desert whereSigilyph fly. The ruins of what may have beenan ancient city were found beneath the sands.
name: Sigilyph

flavor_text: Its antennae, which evolved from a fin, have bothpositive and negative charges flowing through them.
name: Chinchou

flavor_text: On the dark ocean floor, its only means ofcommunication is its constantly flashing lights.
name: Chinchou

flavor_text: This Pokémon has a body of sparkling gold.People say it no longer remembers that it wasonce human.
name: Cofagrigus

flavor_text: There are many depictions of Cofagrigusdecorating ancient tombs. They’re symbolsof the wealth that kings of bygone eras had.
name: Cofagrigus

flavor_text: It wanders through ruins by night, carrying a maskthat’s said to have been the face it had when itwas still human.
name: Yamask

flavor_text: The spirit of a person from a bygone age becamethis Pokémon. It rambles through ruins, searchingfor someone who knows its face.
name: Yamask

flavor_text: Once every 1,000 years, the singing of a purevoice will rouse this Pokémon from its near-perpetual slumber. It wakes for only seven days.
name: Jirachi

flavor_text: It’s believed that when this Pokémon wakes fromits 1,000-year slumber, it will grant any wisheswritten on the notes attached to its head.
name: Jirachi

flavor_text: RAYQUAZA lived for hundreds of millionsof years in the earth’s ozone layer, never descending to the ground.This POKéMON appears to feed on waterand particles in the atmosphere.
name: Rayquaza

flavor_text: It uses differentkinds of cries forcommunicating withothers of its kindand for pursuingits prey.
name: Houndour

flavor_text: If you are burnedby the flames itshoots from itsmouth, the painwill never goaway.
name: Houndoom

flavor_text: LATIOS has the ability to make its foesee an image of what it has seen orimagines in its head.This POKéMON is intelligent andunderstands human speech.
name: Latios

flavor_text: LATIAS is highly sensitive to theemotions of people. If it senses anyhostility, this POKéMON ruffles thefeathers all over its body and criesshrilly to intimidate the foe.
name: Latias

flavor_text: GROUDON has long been described in mythology as the POKéMON that raisedlands and expanded continents.This POKéMON took to sleep after acataclysmic battle with KYOGRE.
name: Groudon

flavor_text: KYOGRE has the power to create massiverain clouds that cover the entire skyand bring about torrential downpours.This POKéMON saved people who weresuffering from droughts.
name: Kyogre

flavor_text: It will regrow any branches that break off itshead. People keep particularly beautiful Corsolabranches as charms to promote safe childbirth.
name: Corsola

flavor_text: These Pokémon live in warm seas.In prehistoric times, many lived in theoceans around the Galar region as well.
name: Corsola

flavor_text: The water they shoot from their mouths can hitmoving prey from more than 300 feet away.
name: Remoraid

flavor_text: Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it clings to aMantine’s underside to scavenge for leftovers.
name: Remoraid

flavor_text: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig upfood. It sometimes discovers hot springs.
name: Swinub

flavor_text: If it smells something enticing, it dashes offheadlong to find the source of the aroma.
name: Swinub

flavor_text: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its backstand up straight. It is very sensitive to sound.
name: Piloswine

flavor_text: Although its legs are short, its rugged hoovesprevent it from slipping, even on icy ground.
name: Piloswine

flavor_text: If it builds up enough speed swimming, itcan jump out above the waves and glidefor over 300 feet.
name: Mantine

flavor_text: As it majestically swims, it doesn’t care ifRemoraid attach to it to scavenge for its leftovers.
name: Mantine

flavor_text: The pointed feathers of these Pokémon aresharper than swords. Skarmory and Corviknightfight viciously over territory.
name: Skarmory

flavor_text: People fashion swords from Skarmory’s shedfeathers, so this Pokémon is a popular elementin heraldic designs.
name: Skarmory

flavor_text: It has a tendency to want to be in holes. Itprefers rock crags or pots and sprays ink fromthem before attacking.
name: Octillery

flavor_text: It traps enemies with its suction-cuppedtentacles, then smashes them with itsrock-hard head.
name: Octillery

flavor_text: It carries food all day long. There are tales aboutlost people who were saved by the food it had.
name: Delibird

flavor_text: It has a generous habit of sharing its food withpeople and Pokémon, so it’s always scroungingaround for more food.
name: Delibird

flavor_text: Audino’s sense of hearing is superb. Not even apebble rolling along over a mile away will escapeAudino’s ears.
name: Audino

flavor_text: This Pokémon has a kind heart. By touching withits feelers, Audino can gauge other creatures’feelings and physical conditions.
name: Audino

flavor_text: Igglybuff loves to sing. Its marshmallow-like bodygives off a faint sweet smell.
name: Igglybuff

flavor_text: Taking advantage of the softness of its body,Igglybuff moves as if bouncing. Its body turns adeep pink when its temperature rises.
name: Igglybuff

flavor_text: It aimed for the top but got lost and ended upon a snowy mountain. Being forced to endurethe cold, this Pokémon evolved and grew fur.
name: Crabominable

flavor_text: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is saidthat it will share good luck when treated kindly.
name: Togepi

flavor_text: It is considered to be a symbol of good luck.Its shell is said to be filled with happiness.
name: Togepi

flavor_text: As halfhearted as this Pokémon’s kicks may seem,they pack enough power to shatter Conkeldurr’sconcrete pillars.
name: Scrafty

flavor_text: While mostly known for having the temperamentof an aggressive ruffian, this Pokémon takes verygood care of its family, friends, and territory.
name: Scrafty

flavor_text: People fear it due to a belief that it devours anywho try to cut down trees in its forest, but to thePokémon it shares its woods with, it’s kind.
name: Trevenant

flavor_text: Small roots that extend from the tips of thisPokémon’s feet can tie into the trees of theforest and give Trevenant control over them.
name: Trevenant

flavor_text: After a lost child perished in the forest, theirspirit possessed a tree stump, causing the spirit’srebirth as this Pokémon.
name: Phantump

flavor_text: With a voice like a human child’s, it cries out tolure adults deep into the forest, getting them lostamong the trees.
name: Phantump

flavor_text: It won’t attack while it’s alone—not even if itspots prey. Instead, it waits for other Carvanha tojoin it, and then the Pokémon attack as a group.
name: Carvanha

flavor_text: These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerfuljaws. Sailors avoid Carvanha dens at all costs.
name: Carvanha

flavor_text: As soon as it catches the scent of prey, Sharpedowill jet seawater from its backside, hurtlingtoward the target to attack at 75 mph.
name: Sharpedo

flavor_text: This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sea.Any ship entering the waters Sharpedo callshome will be attacked—no exceptions.
name: Sharpedo

flavor_text: Virtually all of GULPIN’s body is itsstomach. As a result, it can swallowsomething its own size.This POKéMON’s stomach contains aspecial fluid that digests anything.
name: Gulpin

flavor_text: When SWALOT spots prey, it spurts outa hideously toxic fluid from its poresand sprays the target.Once the prey has weakened, thisPOKéMON gulps it down whole with itscavernous mouth.
name: Swalot

flavor_text: ILLUMISE attracts a swarm of VOLBEATusing a sweet fragrance. Once theVOLBEAT have gathered, this POKéMONleads the lit-up swarm in drawinggeometric designs on the canvas ofthe night sky.
name: Illumise

flavor_text: Its flowers give off a relaxing fragrance.The stronger its aroma, the healthierthe Roselia is.
name: Roselia

flavor_text: It uses the different poisons in each handseparately when it attacks. The stronger itsaroma, the healthier it is.
name: Roselia

flavor_text: MINUN is more concerned about cheeringon its partners than its own safety.It shorts out the electricity in itsbody to create brilliant showers ofsparks to cheer on its teammates.
name: Minun

flavor_text: With the arrival of night, VOLBEAT emitslight from its tail. It communicates withothers by adjusting the intensity andflashing of its light.This POKéMON is attracted by the sweetaroma of ILLUMISE.
name: Volbeat

flavor_text: It stimulates its own muscles with electricity, soit can move quickly. It eases its soreness withelectricity, too, so it can recover quickly as well.
name: Manectric

flavor_text: It rarely appears before people. It is said to nestwhere lightning has fallen.
name: Manectric

flavor_text: PLUSLE always acts as a cheerleaderfor its partners. Whenever a teammateputs out a good effort in battle, thisPOKéMON shorts out its body to createthe crackling noises of sparks to showits joy.
name: Plusle

flavor_text: Once it has stored up enough heat, thisPokémon’s body temperature can reach up to1,700 degrees Fahrenheit.
name: Flareon

flavor_text: It stores some of the air it inhales in its internalflame pouch, which heats it to over3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.
name: Flareon

flavor_text: State-of-the-art technology was used to createPorygon. It was the first artificial Pokémon to becreated via computer programming.
name: Porygon

flavor_text: In recent years, this species has been very helpfulin cyberspace. These Pokémon will go aroundchecking to make sure no suspicious data exists.
name: Porygon

flavor_text: When Vaporeon’s fins begin to vibrate, it is asign that rain will come within a few hours.
name: Vaporeon

flavor_text: Its body’s cellular structure is similar to themolecular composition of water. It can meltinvisibly in water.
name: Vaporeon

flavor_text: If it is angered or startled, the fur all over itsbody bristles like sharp needles that pierce foes.
name: Jolteon

flavor_text: It accumulates negative ions in the atmosphere toblast out 10,000-volt lightning bolts.
name: Jolteon

flavor_text: It can reconstitute its entire cellularstructure to change into what it sees,but it returns to normal when it relaxes.
name: Ditto

flavor_text: When it encounters another Ditto, it will movefaster than normal to duplicate that opponent exactly.
name: Ditto

flavor_text: It has the ability to alter the composition of itsbody to suit its surrounding environment.
name: Eevee

flavor_text: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, thisspecial Pokémon conceals many differentpossible evolutions.
name: Eevee

flavor_text: It has an extremely aggressive nature.The Hyper Beam it shoots from its mouthtotally incinerates all targets.
name: Gyarados

flavor_text: Once it begins to rampage, a Gyarados will burneverything down, even in a harsh storm.
name: Gyarados

flavor_text: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon,it glides across the surface of the sea whileits beautiful song echoes around it.
name: Lapras

flavor_text: Crossing icy seas is no issue for thiscold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skinis a little cool to the touch.
name: Lapras

flavor_text: This Pokémon overcame its sorrow to evolve asturdy new body. Marowak faces its opponentsbravely, using a bone as a weapon.
name: Marowak

flavor_text: When this Pokémon evolved, the skull of itsmother fused to it. Marowak’s temperament alsoturned vicious at the same time.
name: Marowak

flavor_text: Made from soil, the shell on itsback hardens when it drinks water.It lives along lakes.
name: Turtwig

flavor_text: Because some Omanyte manage to escape afterbeing restored or are released into the wild bypeople, this species is becoming a problem.
name: Omanyte

flavor_text: This Pokémon is a member of an ancient, extinctspecies. Omanyte paddles through water with its10 tentacles, looking like it’s just drifting along.
name: Omanyte

flavor_text: Weighed down by a large and heavy shell,Omastar couldn’t move very fast. Some say itwent extinct because it was unable to catch food.
name: Omastar

flavor_text: Omastar’s sharp fangs could crush rock, but thePokémon can attack only the prey that comewithin reach of its tentacles.
name: Omastar

flavor_text: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlesslystands up to bigger and stronger foes.
name: Growlithe

flavor_text: Extremely loyal, it will fearlessly bark at anyopponent to protect its own Trainer from harm.
name: Growlithe

flavor_text: The sight of it running over 6,200 milesin a single day and night has captivatedmany people.
name: Arcanine

flavor_text: A Pokémon that has long been admired for itsbeauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.
name: Arcanine

flavor_text: It loves to collect shiny things. If it’s in a goodmood, it might even let its Trainer have a lookat its hoard of treasures.
name: Meowth

flavor_text: It washes its face regularly to keep the coin onits forehead spotless. It doesn’t get along withGalarian Meowth.
name: Meowth

flavor_text: Getting this prideful Pokémon to warm up to youtakes a lot of effort, and it will claw at you themoment it gets annoyed.
name: Persian

flavor_text: Its elegant and refined behavior clashes with thatof the barbaric Perrserker. The relationshipbetween the two is one of mutual disdain.
name: Persian

flavor_text: If a Diglett digs through a field, it leaves the soilperfectly tilled and ideal for planting crops.
name: Diglett

flavor_text: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth.It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easyto spot.
name: Diglett

flavor_text: A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers hugeearthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.
name: Dugtrio

flavor_text: These Diglett triplets dig over 60 miles below sealevel. No one knows what it’s like underground.
name: Dugtrio

flavor_text: Extremely quick toanger. It couldbe docile onemoment thenthrashing awaythe next instant.
name: Mankey

flavor_text: Always furiousand tenacious toboot. It will notabandon chasingits quarry untilit is caught.
name: Primeape

flavor_text: Psyduck is constantly beset by headaches. If thePokémon lets its strange power erupt, apparentlythe pain subsides for a while.
name: Psyduck

flavor_text: As Psyduck gets stressed out, its headache getsprogressively worse. It uses intense psychicenergy to overwhelm those around it.
name: Psyduck

flavor_text: This Pokémon lives in gently flowing rivers. Itpaddles through the water with its long limbs,putting its graceful swimming skills on display.
name: Golduck

flavor_text: Old tales tell of Golduck punishing those thatdefiled its river. The guilty were dragged intothe water and taken away.
name: Golduck

flavor_text: When the memory of its departed mother bringsit to tears, its cries echo mournfully within theskull it wears on its head.
name: Cubone

flavor_text: This Pokémon wears the skull of its deceasedmother. Sometimes Cubone’s dreams make it cry,but each tear Cubone sheds makes it stronger.
name: Cubone

flavor_text: With power equal to an excavator, it can digthrough dense bedrock. It’s a huge help duringtunnel construction.
name: Diggersby

flavor_text: The fur on its belly retains heat exceptionallywell. People used to make heavy winter clothingfrom fur shed by this Pokémon.
name: Diggersby

flavor_text: It makes pollen puffs from pollen and nectar.The puffs’ effects depend on the type ofingredients and how much of each one is used.
name: Ribombee

flavor_text: Ribombee absolutely hate getting wet orrained on. In the cloudy Galar region,they are very seldom seen.
name: Ribombee

flavor_text: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 poundsof food every day. When it is done eating, itgoes promptly to sleep.
name: Snorlax

flavor_text: This Pokémon’s stomach is so strong, even eatingmoldy or rotten food will not affect it.
name: Snorlax

flavor_text: This is a ferocious Pokémon from ancient times.Apparently even modern technology is incapableof producing a perfectly restored specimen.
name: Aerodactyl

flavor_text: Aerodactyl’s sawlike fangs can shred skin totatters—even the skin of Steel-type Pokémon.
name: Aerodactyl

flavor_text: Kabutops slices its prey apart and sucks outthe fluids. The discarded body parts becomefood for other Pokémon.
name: Kabutops

flavor_text: The cause behind the extinction of this species isunknown. Kabutops were aggressive Pokémonthat inhabited warm seas.
name: Kabutops

flavor_text: This species is almost entirely extinct. Kabutomolt every three days, making their shells harderand harder.
name: Kabuto

flavor_text: While some say this species has gone extinct,Kabuto sightings are apparently fairly commonin some places.
name: Kabuto

flavor_text: Dratini dwells near bodies of rapidly flowingwater, such as the plunge pools of waterfalls.As it grows, Dratini will shed its skin many times.
name: Dratini

flavor_text: This Pokémon was long considered to be nomore than a myth. The small lump on a Dratini’sforehead is actually a horn that’s still coming in.
name: Dratini

flavor_text: It’s one of the legendary bird Pokémon. WhenMoltres flaps its flaming wings, they glimmer witha dazzling red glow.
name: Moltres

flavor_text: There are stories of this Pokémon using itsradiant, flame-cloaked wings to light up pathsfor those lost in the mountains.
name: Moltres

flavor_text: This Pokémon has complete control overelectricity. There are tales of Zapdos nesting inthe dark depths of pitch-black thunderclouds.
name: Zapdos

flavor_text: Zapdos is a legendary bird Pokémon. It’s saidthat when Zapdos rubs its feathers together,lightning will fall immediately after.
name: Zapdos

flavor_text: It’s said that this Pokémon’s beautiful blue wingsare made of ice. Articuno flies over snowymountains, its long tail fluttering along behind it.
name: Articuno

flavor_text: This Pokémon can control ice at will. Articunois said to live in snowy mountains riddledwith permafrost.
name: Articuno

flavor_text: It’s a kindhearted Pokémon. If it spots a drowningperson or Pokémon, Dragonite simply musthelp them.
name: Dragonite

flavor_text: This Pokémon is known as the Sea Incarnate.Figureheads that resemble Dragonite decoratethe bows of many ships.
name: Dragonite

flavor_text: This Pokémon lives in pristine oceans and lakes.It can control the weather, and it uses this powerto fly into the sky, riding on the wind.
name: Dragonair

flavor_text: This Pokémon gathers power in the orbs on itstail and controls the weather. When enshroudedby an aura, Dragonair has a mystical appearance.
name: Dragonair

flavor_text: It has phenomenal power. It will mercilessly crushanyone or anything that bullies small Pokémon.
name: Terrakion

flavor_text: In Unovan legend, Terrakion battled againsthumans in an effort to protect other Pokémon.
name: Terrakion

flavor_text: This Pokémon appears in a legend alongsideTerrakion and Virizion, fighting against humans indefense of the Unova region’s Pokémon.
name: Cobalion

flavor_text: From the moment it’s born, this Pokémonradiates the air of a leader. Its presence willcalm even vicious foes.
name: Cobalion

flavor_text: Its melodious cries are actually warnings.Fletchling will mercilessly peck at anythingthat enters its territory.
name: Fletchling

flavor_text: When this Pokémon gets excited, its bodytemperature increases sharply. If you touch aFletchling with bare hands, you might get burned.
name: Fletchling

flavor_text: No one knows what the Poké Ball–like pattern onFoongus means or why Foongus has it.
name: Foongus

flavor_text: The spores released from this Pokémon’s handsare highly poisonous, but when thoroughly dried,the spores can be used as stomach medicine.
name: Foongus

flavor_text: Small Pokémon occasionally gatheron its unmoving back to beginbuilding their nests.
name: Torterra

flavor_text: Nectar and pollen are its favorite fare. You canfind Cutiefly hovering around Gossifleur, tryingto get some of Gossifleur’s pollen.
name: Cutiefly

flavor_text: An opponent’s aura can tell Cutiefly what thatopponent’s next move will be. Then Cutiefly canglide around the attack and strike back.
name: Cutiefly

flavor_text: It lives along water in forests. Inthe daytime, it leaves the forestto sunbathe its treed shell.
name: Grotle

flavor_text: Though it may look like it’s just a bunch of eggs,it’s a proper Pokémon. Exeggcute communicateswith others of its kind via telepathy, apparently.
name: Exeggcute

flavor_text: These Pokémon get nervous when they’re not in agroup of six. The minute even one member of thegroup goes missing, Exeggcute become cowardly.
name: Exeggcute

flavor_text: It performs throwing moves with first-rate skill.Over the course of many battles, Throh’s beltgrows darker as it absorbs its wearer’s sweat.
name: Throh

flavor_text: They train in groups of five. Any member thatcan’t keep up will discard its belt and leavethe group.
name: Throh

flavor_text: It stores electricenergy under veryhigh pressure.It often explodeswith little or noprovocation.
name: Electrode

flavor_text: When it heats up, its body temperature reachesabout 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes itsbody like a whip and launches itself at enemies.
name: Centiskorch

flavor_text: While its burning body is already dangerous onits own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also haslarge and very sharp fangs.
name: Centiskorch

flavor_text: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it togenerate heat. The yellow sections on its bellyget particularly hot.
name: Sizzlipede

flavor_text: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cookingthem in its coils. Once they’re well-done, it willvoraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.
name: Sizzlipede

flavor_text: A body made up of nothing but muscle makesthe grappling moves this Pokémon performs withits tentacles tremendously powerful.
name: Grapploct

flavor_text: Searching for an opponent to test its skillsagainst, it emerges onto land. Once the battleis over, it returns to the sea.
name: Grapploct

flavor_text: It’s very curious, but its means of investigatingthings is to try to punch them with its tentacles.The search for food is what brings it onto land.
name: Clobbopus

flavor_text: Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn’t alarmedwhen that happens—it knows they’ll grow back.It’s about as smart as a three-year-old.
name: Clobbopus

flavor_text: This species lives in antique teapots.Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions,an authentic work is found.
name: Polteageist

flavor_text: Leaving leftover black tea unattended is askingfor this Pokémon to come along and pour itselfinto it, turning the tea into a new Polteageist.
name: Polteageist

flavor_text: This Pokémon is said to have been born whena lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cupof tea.
name: Sinistea

flavor_text: The teacup in which this Pokémon makes itshome is a famous piece of antique tableware.Many forgeries are in circulation.
name: Sinistea

flavor_text: No matter who you are, if you bring strongemotions near this Pokémon, it will silenceyou violently.
name: Hattrem

flavor_text: Using the braids on its head, it pummels foes toget them to quiet down. One blow from thosebraids would knock out a professional boxer.
name: Hattrem

flavor_text: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses othercreatures’ emotions. If you don’t have a calmdisposition, it will never warm up to you.
name: Hatenna

flavor_text: If this Pokémon senses a strong emotion, itwill run away as fast as it can. It prefers areaswithout people.
name: Hatenna

flavor_text: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanationsproduced by people and Pokémon when theyfeel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.
name: Impidimp

flavor_text: It sneaks into people’s homes, stealing thingsand feasting on the negative energy of thefrustrated occupants.
name: Impidimp

flavor_text: It emits psychic power strong enough to causeheadaches as a deterrent to the approachof others.
name: Hatterene

flavor_text: If you’re too loud around it, you risk being tornapart by the claws on its tentacle. This Pokémonis also known as the Forest Witch.
name: Hatterene

flavor_text: Usually found inpower plants.Easily mistakenfor a POKé BALL,they have zappedmany people.
name: Voltorb

flavor_text: Unfezant are exceptional fliers. The femalesare known for their stamina, while the malesoutclass them in terms of speed.
name: Unfezant

flavor_text: This Pokémon is intelligent and intensely proud.People will sit up and take notice if you becomethe Trainer of one.
name: Unfezant

flavor_text: It can fly moderately quickly. No matter how farit travels, it can always find its way back to itsmaster and its nest.
name: Tranquill

flavor_text: These bright Pokémon have acute memories.Apparently delivery workers often choose themas their partners.
name: Tranquill

flavor_text: They have lightning-like movements.When Zebstrika run at full speed,the sound of thunder reverberates.
name: Zebstrika

flavor_text: Its mane shines when it dischargeselectricity. They use their flashingmanes to communicate with one another.
name: Blitzle

flavor_text: If you see its orange crystals start to glow, bewary. It’s about to fire off bursts of energy.
name: Boldore

flavor_text: It relies on sound in order to monitor what’s in itsvicinity. When angered, it will attack without everchanging the direction it’s facing.
name: Boldore

flavor_text: It’s as hard as steel, but apparently a long soak inwater will cause it to soften a bit.
name: Roggenrola

flavor_text: When it detects a noise, it starts to move.The energy core inside it makes this Pokémonslightly warm to the touch.
name: Roggenrola

flavor_text: While inside a cave, if you look up and see lotsof heart-shaped marks lining the walls, it’sevidence that Woobat live there.
name: Woobat

flavor_text: It emits ultrasonic waves as it flutters about,searching for its prey—bug Pokémon.
name: Woobat

flavor_text: This hardy Pokémon can often be found onconstruction sites and in mines, workingalongside people and Copperajah.
name: Gigalith

flavor_text: Although its energy blasts can blow awaya dump truck, they have a limitation—they can only be fired when the sun is out.
name: Gigalith

flavor_text: It brings its claws together and whirls around athigh speed before rushing toward its prey.
name: Drilbur

flavor_text: It’s a digger, using its claws to burrow through theground. It causes damage to vegetable crops, somany farmers have little love for it.
name: Drilbur

flavor_text: Emitting powerful sound waves tires it out.Afterward, it won’t be able to fly for alittle while.
name: Swoobat

flavor_text: The auspicious shape of this Pokémon’s noseapparently led some regions to considerSwoobat a symbol of good luck.
name: Swoobat

flavor_text: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning,it triggers the explosion of its own head.It’s apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.
name: Blacephalon

flavor_text: Mud that hardens around a Mudsdale’s legssets harder than stone. It’s so hard that it allowsthis Pokémon to scrap a truck with a single kick.
name: Mudsdale

flavor_text: Mudsdale has so much stamina that it could carryover 10 tons across the Galar region without restor sleep.
name: Mudsdale

flavor_text: It wears a rag fashioned into a Pikachu costumein an effort to look less scary. Unfortunately,the costume only makes it creepier.
name: Mimikyu

flavor_text: There was a scientist who peeked underMimikyu’s old rag in the name of research.The scientist died of a mysterious disease.
name: Mimikyu

flavor_text: When it unleashes its psychic power from theprotuberance on its head, the grating soundof grinding teeth echoes through the area.
name: Bruxish

flavor_text: By releasing enmity-erasing waves from itsribbonlike feelers, Sylveon stops any conflict.
name: Sylveon

flavor_text: There’s a Galarian fairy tale that describesa beautiful Sylveon vanquishing a dreadfuldragon Pokémon.
name: Sylveon

flavor_text: KECLEON is capable of changing its bodycolors at will to blend in with itssurroundings.There is one exception - this POKéMONcan’t change the zigzag pattern on itsbelly.
name: Kecleon

flavor_text: SHUPPET is attracted by feelingsof jealousy and vindictiveness.If someone develops strong feelings ofvengeance, this POKéMON will appearin a swarm and line up beneath the eavesof that person’s home.
name: Shuppet

flavor_text: NOSEPASS’s magnetic nose is alwayspointed to the north. If two of thesePOKéMON meet, they cannot turntheir faces to each other when theyare close because their magnetic nosesrepel one another.
name: Nosepass

flavor_text: The ball on Azurill’s tail bounces like a rubberball, and it’s full of the nutrients the Pokémonneeds to grow.
name: Azurill

flavor_text: Although Azurill are normally docile, an angryone will swing around the big ball on its tail andtry to smash its opponents.
name: Azurill

flavor_text: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens itsmouth, it sucks everything in as if it were ablack hole.
name: Dusclops

flavor_text: It seeks drifting will-o’-the-wisps and sucks theminto its empty body. What happens inside isa mystery.
name: Dusclops

flavor_text: The bunches of fruit around TROPIUS’sneck are very popular with children.This POKéMON loves fruit, and eats itcontinuously. Apparently, its love forfruit resulted in its own outgrowthof fruit.
name: Tropius

flavor_text: BANETTE generates energy for layingstrong curses by sticking pins into itsown body.This POKéMON was originally a pitifulplush doll that was thrown away.
name: Banette

flavor_text: If it finds bad children who won’t listen to theirparents, it will spirit them away—or so it’s said.
name: Duskull

flavor_text: Making itself invisible, it silently sneaks up toprey. It has the ability to slip through thick walls.
name: Duskull

flavor_text: The cry of a Whismur is over 100 decibels.If you’re close to a Whismur when it lets out acry, you’ll be stuck with an all-day headache.
name: Whismur

flavor_text: When Whismur cries, the sound of its own voicestartles it, making the Pokémon cry even louder.It cries until it’s exhausted, then it falls asleep.
name: Whismur

flavor_text: A most peculiar Pokémon that somehow appearsin a Poké Ball when a Nincada evolves.
name: Shedinja

flavor_text: A strange Pokémon—it flies without moving itswings, has a hollow shell for a body, and doesnot breathe.
name: Shedinja

flavor_text: Its cry leaves a lasting headache if heard for toolong. It moves so quickly that it is almost invisible.
name: Ninjask

flavor_text: This Pokémon is so quick, it is said to be able toavoid any attack. It loves to feed on tree sap.
name: Ninjask

flavor_text: Because it lived almost entirely underground,it is nearly blind. It uses its antennae instead.
name: Nincada

flavor_text: It can sometimes live underground for more than10 years. It absorbs nutrients from the rootsof trees.
name: Nincada

flavor_text: HARIYAMA practices its straight-armslaps in any number of locations.One hit of this POKéMON’s powerful,openhanded, straight-arm punchescould snap a telephone pole in two.
name: Hariyama

flavor_text: MAKUHITA is tenacious - it will keepgetting up and attacking its foehowever many times it is knocked down.Every time it gets back up, thisPOKéMON stores more energy in its bodyfor evolving.
name: Makuhita

flavor_text: In the past, people would use the loud voices ofthese Pokémon as a means of communicationbetween distant cities.
name: Exploud

flavor_text: This Pokémon can do more than just shout. Tocommunicate with others of its kind, it’ll emit allsorts of sounds from the holes in its body.
name: Exploud

flavor_text: Loudred’s ears serve as speakers, and they canput out sound waves powerful enough to blowaway a house.
name: Loudred

flavor_text: The force of this Pokémon’s loud voice isn’t justthe sound—it’s also the wave of air pressure thatblows opponents away and damages them.
name: Loudred

flavor_text: The special membrane envelopingAlomomola has the ability to heal wounds.
name: Alomomola

flavor_text: Joltik can be found clinging to other Pokémon.It’s soaking up static electricity because it can’tproduce a charge on its own.
name: Joltik

flavor_text: Joltik latch on to other Pokémon and suck outstatic electricity. They’re often found sticking toYamper’s hindquarters.
name: Joltik

flavor_text: It launches electrified fur from its abdomen as itsmeans of attack. Opponents hit by the fur couldbe in for three full days and nights of paralysis.
name: Galvantula

flavor_text: It lays traps of electrified threads near the nestsof bird Pokémon, aiming to snare chicks that arenot yet good at flying.
name: Galvantula

flavor_text: It defends itself by launching spikes, but itsaim isn’t very good at first. Only after a lot ofpractice will it improve.
name: Ferroseed

flavor_text: Mossy caves are their preferred dwellings.Enzymes contained in mosses help Ferroseed’sspikes grow big and strong.
name: Ferroseed

flavor_text: It lives on snowy mountains. It sinks its legs intothe snow to absorb water and keep its owntemperature down.
name: Snover

flavor_text: The berries that grow around its belly are likeice pops. Galarian Darumaka absolutely lovethese berries.
name: Snover

flavor_text: Mantyke living in Galar seem to be somewhatsluggish. The colder waters of the seas in thisregion may be the cause.
name: Mantyke

flavor_text: It swims along with a school of Remoraid, andthey’ll all fight together to repel attackers.
name: Mantyke

flavor_text: It envelops its prey in its veillike arms and drawsit down to the deeps, five miles below theocean’s surface.
name: Frillish

flavor_text: Legend has it that the residents of a sunkenancient city changed into these Pokémon.
name: Frillish

flavor_text: Most of this Pokémon’s body composition isidentical to sea water. It makes sunken shipsits lair.
name: Jellicent

flavor_text: Whenever a full moon hangs in the night sky,schools of Jellicent gather near the surface ofthe sea, waiting for their prey to appear.
name: Jellicent

flavor_text: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down.It takes a whole day to eat prey.
name: Carnivine

flavor_text: It bounces toward opponents and gouges themwith poisonous claws. No more than a scratchis needed to knock out its adversaries.
name: Toxicroak

flavor_text: It booms out a victory croak when its preygoes down in defeat. This Pokémon andSeismitoad are related species.
name: Toxicroak

flavor_text: It lives on the deep-sea floor.It attracts prey by flashing thepatterns on its four tail fins.
name: Lumineon

flavor_text: After long exposure to sunlight,the patterns on its tail fins shinevividly when darkness arrives.
name: Finneon

flavor_text: After burrowing into the sand, it waits patientlyfor prey to come near. This Pokémon andSizzlipede share common descent.
name: Skorupi

flavor_text: It attacks using the claws on its tail. Once lockedin its grip, its prey is unable to move as thisPokémon’s poison seeps in.
name: Skorupi

flavor_text: Stones can get stuck in the ports on their bodies.Dwebble help dislodge such stones, soHippowdon look after these Pokémon.
name: Hippowdon

flavor_text: When roused to violence by its rage, it spews outthe quantities of sand it has swallowed andwhips up a sandstorm.
name: Hippowdon

flavor_text: It makes frightening noises with its poison-filledcheek sacs. When opponents flinch, Croagunkhits them with a poison jab.
name: Croagunk

flavor_text: Once diluted, its poison becomes medicinal.This Pokémon came into popularity after apharmaceutical company chose it as a mascot.
name: Croagunk

flavor_text: Its poison is potent, but it rarely sees use. ThisPokémon prefers to use physical force instead,going on rampages with its car-crushing strength.
name: Drapion

flavor_text: It’s so vicious that it’s called the Sand Demon.Yet when confronted by Hippowdon, Drapionkeeps a low profile and will never pick a fight.
name: Drapion

flavor_text: A Pokémon that was feared as a forest guardian.It can read the foe’s mind and takepreemptive action.
name: Shiftry

flavor_text: It lives quietly in the deep forest. It is said tocreate chilly winter winds with the fans it holds.
name: Shiftry

flavor_text: It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head,it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.
name: Nuzleaf

flavor_text: They live in holes bored in large trees. The soundof Nuzleaf’s grass flute fills listeners with dread.
name: Nuzleaf

flavor_text: They say that it stays still and quiet because it isseeing both the past and future at the same time.
name: Xatu

flavor_text: This odd Pokémon can see both the past andthe future. It eyes the sun’s movement all day.
name: Xatu

flavor_text: If static elec­tricity builds inits body, itsfleece doubles involume. Touchingit will shock you.
name: Mareep

flavor_text: It is nocturnal and becomes active at nightfall.It feeds on aquatic mosses that growin the riverbed.
name: Lombre

flavor_text: It lives at the water’s edge where it is sunny.It sleeps on a bed of water grass by day andbecomes active at night.
name: Lombre

flavor_text: It searches about for clean water. If it does notdrink water for too long, the leaf on itshead wilts.
name: Lotad

flavor_text: Its leaf grew too large for it to live on land.That is how it began to live floating in the water.
name: Lotad

flavor_text: It can be found near the sea. The large pincersgrow back if they are torn out of their sockets.
name: Krabby

flavor_text: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itselfwith bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.
name: Krabby

flavor_text: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepowerstrength. However, being so big, it is unwieldyto move.
name: Kingler

flavor_text: Its oversized claw is very powerful, but when it’snot in battle, the claw just gets in the way.
name: Kingler

flavor_text: Puts enemies tosleep then eatstheir dreams.Occasionally getssick from eatingbad dreams.
name: Drowzee

flavor_text: When it locks eyeswith an enemy, itwill use a mix ofPSI moves such asHYPNOSIS andCONFUSION.
name: Hypno

flavor_text: On the night of a full moon, if shadows move ontheir own and laugh, it must be Gengar’s doing.
name: Gengar

flavor_text: It is said to emerge from darkness to steal thelives of those who become lost in mountains.
name: Gengar

flavor_text: As it digs through the ground, it absorbs manyhard objects. This is what makes its body so solid.
name: Onix

flavor_text: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph bysquirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.
name: Onix

flavor_text: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfedby its gaseous body, which contains poison.
name: Gastly

flavor_text: With its gas-like body, it can sneak into any placeit desires. However, it can be blown away by wind.
name: Gastly

flavor_text: Its tongue is made of gas. If licked, its victimstarts shaking constantly until deatheventually comes.
name: Haunter

flavor_text: If you get the feeling of being watched in darknesswhen nobody is around, Haunter is there.
name: Haunter

flavor_text: It swims facing backward by opening and closingits two-piece shell. It is surprisingly fast.
name: Shellder

flavor_text: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It isvulnerable only when its shell is open.
name: Shellder

flavor_text: Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot be shattered,even with a bomb. The shell opens only when itis attacking.
name: Cloyster

flavor_text: Once it slams its shell shut, it is impossible toopen, even by those with superior strength.
name: Cloyster

flavor_text: To keep from beingblown away by thewind, they gatherin clusters. Theydo enjoy gentlebreezes, though.
name: Hoppip

flavor_text: At nightfall, these Pokémon appear on the shoresof lakes. They announce their territorial claims byletting out cries that sound like shouting.
name: Politoed

flavor_text: The cry of a male is louder than that of a female.Male Politoed with deep, menacing voices findmore popularity with the opposite gender.
name: Politoed

flavor_text: If a tree branch shakes when there is no wind, it’sa Sudowoodo, not a tree. It hides from the rain.
name: Sudowoodo

flavor_text: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hateswater, so it will disappear if it starts raining.
name: Sudowoodo

flavor_text: It spends most of its time in the water. On sunnydays, Azumarill floats on the surface of the waterand sunbathes.
name: Azumarill

flavor_text: These Pokémon create air-filled bubbles. WhenAzurill play in rivers, Azumarill will cover themwith these bubbles.
name: Azumarill

flavor_text: This Pokémon uses its round tail as a float. Theball of Marill’s tail is filled with nutrients thathave been turned into an oil.
name: Marill

flavor_text: Even after Marill swims in a cold sea, its water-repellent fur dries almost as soon as Marill leavesthe water. That’s why this Pokémon is never cold.
name: Marill

flavor_text: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petalsrub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.
name: Bellossom

flavor_text: Bellossom gather at times and appear to dance.They say that the dance is a ritual to summonthe sun.
name: Bellossom

flavor_text: The tail's tipshines brightlyand can be seenfrom far away. Itacts as a beaconfor lost people.
name: Ampharos

flavor_text: As a result ofstoring too muchelectricity, itdeveloped patcheswhere even downywool won't grow.
name: Flaaffy

flavor_text: Its powerful head butt has enoughpower to shatter even the mostdurable things upon impact.
name: Rampardos

flavor_text: Once it catchesthe wind, it deft­ly controls itscotton-puff sporesto float, evenaround the world.
name: Jumpluff

flavor_text: The bloom on topof its head opensand closes as thetemperature fluc­tuates up anddown.
name: Skiploom

flavor_text: Honedge’s soul once belonged to a person whowas killed a long time ago by the sword thatmakes up Honedge’s body.
name: Honedge

flavor_text: The blue eye on the sword’s handguard is thetrue body of Honedge. With its old cloth, itdrains people’s lives away.
name: Honedge

flavor_text: Revealing the eyelike patterns on the insides ofits ears will unleash its psychic powers. It normallykeeps the patterns hidden, however.
name: Meowstic

flavor_text: The defensive instinct of the males is strong.It’s when they’re protecting themselves or theirpartners that they unleash their full power.
name: Meowstic

flavor_text: Rumor has it that the theft of top-secret researchnotes led to a new instance of this Pokémonbeing created in the Galar region.
name: Type: Null

flavor_text: It was modeled after a mighty Pokémon of myth.The mask placed upon it limits its power in orderto keep it under control.
name: Type: Null

flavor_text: A solid bond of trust between this Pokémon andits Trainer awakened the strength hidden withinSilvally. It can change its type at will.
name: Silvally

flavor_text: The final factor needed to release thisPokémon’s true power was a strong bondwith a Trainer it trusts.
name: Silvally

flavor_text: Originally making its home in the ozone layer,it hurtles to the ground when the shell enclosingits body grows too heavy.
name: Minior

flavor_text: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All itsmovements are apparently no more than theresults of it tossing and turning in its dreams.
name: Komala

flavor_text: Explosive substances coat the shell on its back.Enemies that dare attack it will be blown awayby an immense detonation.
name: Turtonator

flavor_text: Eating sulfur in its volcanic habitat is what causesexplosive compounds to develop in its shell.Its droppings are also dangerously explosive.
name: Turtonator

flavor_text: With the long hairs on its back, this Pokémontakes in electricity from other electric Pokémon.It stores what it absorbs in an electric sac.
name: Togedemaru

flavor_text: When it’s in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makesits fur spikes stand on end, and then dischargeselectricity indiscriminately.
name: Togedemaru

flavor_text: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory,and it obtains power from basking in the energyemitted by flowering plants.
name: Florges

flavor_text: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares forflowers that are starting to wilt. It drawsout the hidden power of flowers to battle.
name: Floette

flavor_text: It can tell how its Trainer is feeling bysubtle shifts in the grip on its horns.This empathic sense lets them run as if one being.
name: Gogoat

flavor_text: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live inharmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.
name: Skiddo

flavor_text: This Pokémon is quick to anger, and it has noproblem using its prodigious strength to get itsway. It lives for duels against Obstagoon.
name: Pangoro

flavor_text: Using its leaf, Pangoro can predict the moves ofits opponents. It strikes with punches that canturn a dump truck into scrap with just one hit.
name: Pangoro

flavor_text: It chooses a Pangoro as its master and thenimitates its master’s actions. This is how it learnsto battle and hunt for prey.
name: Pancham

flavor_text: Wanting to make sure it’s taken seriously,Pancham’s always giving others a glare.But if it’s not focusing, it ends up smiling.
name: Pancham

flavor_text: Though Espurr’s expression never changes,behind that blank stare is an intense struggle tocontain its devastating psychic power.
name: Espurr

flavor_text: There’s enough psychic power in Espurr to send awrestler flying, but because this power can’t becontrolled, Espurr finds it troublesome.
name: Espurr

flavor_text: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makesit more elegant but also increases theswiftness of its movements.
name: Furfrou

flavor_text: It mixes gases between its two bodies.It’s said that these Pokémon were seenall over the Galar region back in the day.
name: Weezing

flavor_text: It can’t suck in air quite as well as a GalarianWeezing, but the toxins it creates are morepotent than those of its counterpart.
name: Weezing

flavor_text: Moves silentlyand stealthily.Eats the eggs ofbirds, such asPIDGEY andSPEAROW, whole.
name: Ekans

flavor_text: With its huge andmagnificent wings,it can keep aloftwithout everhaving to landfor rest.
name: Fearow

flavor_text: Eats bugs ingrassy areas. Ithas to flap itsshort wings athigh speed tostay airborne.
name: Spearow

flavor_text: It uses its whis­kers to maintainits balance.It apparentlyslows down ifthey are cut off.
name: Raticate

flavor_text: It loves to bathe in the grit of dry, sandy areas.By sand bathing, the Pokémon rids itself of dirtand moisture clinging to its body.
name: Sandshrew

flavor_text: It burrows into the ground to create its nest. Ifhard stones impede its tunneling, it uses its sharpclaws to shatter them and then carries on digging.
name: Sandshrew

flavor_text: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itselffrom its own high-voltage power.
name: Raichu

flavor_text: If its electric pouches run empty, it raises its tailto gather electricity from the atmosphere.
name: Raichu

flavor_text: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricityhave cheek sacs that are extra soft andsuper stretchy.
name: Pikachu

flavor_text: When Pikachu meet, they’ll touch their tailstogether and exchange electricity through themas a form of greeting.
name: Pikachu

flavor_text: It is rumored thatthe ferociouswarning markingson its bellydiffer from areato area.
name: Arbok

flavor_text: When light radiates from its body, this Pokémoncould almost appear to be the sun. It will dispelany darkness and light up the world.
name: Solgaleo

flavor_text: Solgaleo was once known as the Beast ThatDevours the Sun. Energy in the form of lightradiates boundlessly from it.
name: Solgaleo

flavor_text: CAMERUPT has a volcano inside its body.Magma of 18,000 degrees F coursesthrough its body.Occasionally, the humps on thisPOKéMON’s back erupt, spewing thesuperheated magma.
name: Camerupt

flavor_text: Females are more sensitive to smells than males.While foraging, they’ll use their whiskers to checkwind direction and stay downwind of predators.
name: Nidoran♀

flavor_text: It uses its hard incisor teeth to crush and eatberries. The tip of a female Nidoran’s horn is abit more rounded than the tip of a male’s horn.
name: Nidoran♀

flavor_text: The drier the area Sandslash lives in, the harderand smoother the Pokémon’s spikes will feelwhen touched.
name: Sandslash

flavor_text: It climbs trees by hooking on with its sharp claws.Sandslash shares the berries it gathers, droppingthem down to Sandshrew waiting below the tree.
name: Sandslash

flavor_text: It forms a water bubble at the rear of its bodyand then covers its head with it. Meeting anotherDewpider means comparing water-bubble sizes.
name: Dewpider

flavor_text: Dewpider normally lives underwater. When itcomes onto land in search of food, it takeswater with it in the form of a bubble on its head.
name: Dewpider

flavor_text: When beset by attackers, Carbink wipes them allout by firing high-energy beams from the gemsembedded in its body.
name: Carbink

flavor_text: It’s said that somewhere in the world, there’sa mineral vein housing a large pack of slumberingCarbink. It’s also said that this pack has a queen.
name: Carbink

flavor_text: NUMEL is extremely dull witted - itdoesn’t notice being hit. However, itcan’t stand hunger for even a second.This POKéMON’s body is a seethingcauldron of boiling magma.
name: Numel

flavor_text: A Dedenne’s whiskers pick up electrical wavesother Dedenne send out. These Pokémon sharelocations of food or electricity with one another.
name: Dedenne

flavor_text: Since Dedenne can’t generate much electricity onits own, it steals electricity from outlets or otherelectric Pokémon.
name: Dedenne

flavor_text: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon canshatter even a skyscraper with its charging tackles.
name: Rhyhorn

flavor_text: It can remember only one thing at a time. Once itstarts rushing, it forgets why it started.
name: Rhyhorn

flavor_text: Although this Pokémon isn’t very strong, its bodyis coated in a caustic slime that can melt throughanything, so predators steer clear of it.
name: Sliggoo

flavor_text: The lump on its back contains its tiny brain.It thinks only of food and escaping its enemies.
name: Sliggoo

flavor_text: Because most of its body is water, it will dry up ifthe weather becomes too arid. It’s consideredthe weakest dragon Pokémon.
name: Goomy

flavor_text: Their horns are powerful sensors. As soon asGoomy pick up any sign of enemies, they go intohiding. This is how they’ve survived.
name: Goomy

flavor_text: This Pokémon is constantly collecting keys.Entrust a Klefki with important keys, and thePokémon will protect them no matter what.
name: Klefki

flavor_text: Klefki sucks in metal ions with the horn toppingits head. It seems this Pokémon loves keys somuch that its head needed to look like one, too.
name: Klefki

flavor_text: It is extremely good at climbing tree trunks andlikes to eat the new sprouts on the trees.
name: Natu

flavor_text: Because its wings aren’t yet fully grown, it has tohop to get around. It is always staringat something.
name: Natu

flavor_text: Sometimes it misunderstands instructions andappears dazed or bewildered. Many Trainersdon’t mind, finding this behavior to be adorable.
name: Goodra

flavor_text: Its form of offense is forcefully stretching out itshorns. The strikes land 100 times harder than anyblow from a heavyweight boxer.
name: Goodra

flavor_text: Druddigon lives in caves, but it never skipssunbathing—it won’t be able to move if its bodygets too cold.
name: Druddigon

flavor_text: Druddigon are vicious and cunning. They take upresidence in nests dug out by other Pokémon,treating the stolen nests as their own lairs.
name: Druddigon

flavor_text: It has the power to predict the future. Its powerpeaks when it is protecting its Trainer.
name: Gardevoir

flavor_text: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychicpower to create a small black hole.
name: Gardevoir

flavor_text: Its nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit in the desert.Once something has fallen in, there is no escape.
name: Trapinch

flavor_text: It makes an inescapable conical pit and lies inwait at the bottom for prey to cometumbling down.
name: Trapinch

flavor_text: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of theGalar region. The black luster of its steel bodycould drive terror into the heart of any foe.
name: Corviknight

flavor_text: With their great intellect and flying skills, thesePokémon very successfully act as the Galarregion’s airborne taxi service.
name: Corviknight

flavor_text: After a piece of seaweed merged with debrisfrom a sunken ship, it was reborn as thisghost Pokémon.
name: Dhelmise

flavor_text: After lowering its anchor, it waits for its prey. Itcatches large Wailord and drains their life-force.
name: Dhelmise

flavor_text: The mountains it calls home are nearly two milesin height. On rare occasions, it descends to playwith the children living in the towns below.
name: Drampa

flavor_text: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up untilit’s angered. When that happens, it stirs up agale and flattens everything around.
name: Drampa

flavor_text: The scaleless, scarred parts of its body aresigns of its strength. It shows them off todefeated opponents.
name: Hakamo-o

flavor_text: Before attacking its enemies, it clashes itsscales together and roars. Its sharp clawsshred the opposition.
name: Hakamo-o

flavor_text: They learn to fight by smashing their head scalestogether. The dueling strengthens both their skillsand their spirits.
name: Jangmo-o

flavor_text: Jangmo-o strikes its scales to communicate withothers of its kind. Its scales are actually fur that’sbecome as hard as metal.
name: Jangmo-o

flavor_text: This guardian deity of Melemele is brimming withcuriosity. It summons thunderclouds and storestheir lightning inside its body.
name: Tapu Koko

flavor_text: It clatters its tail scales to unnerve opponents.This Pokémon will battle only those who standsteadfast in the face of this display.
name: Kommo-o

flavor_text: Certain ruins have paintings of ancient warriorswearing armor made of Kommo-o scales.
name: Kommo-o

flavor_text: It pulls large trees up by the roots and swingsthem around. It causes vegetation to grow,and then it absorbs energy from the growth.
name: Tapu Bulu

flavor_text: This guardian deity of Akala is guilelessly cruel.The fragrant aroma of flowers is the source ofits energy.
name: Tapu Lele

flavor_text: This Pokémon came from another universe.Its gaseous body is so light that even a gentlebreeze can blow it away.
name: Cosmog

flavor_text: Cosmog is very curious but not very cautious,often placing itself in danger. If things start tolook dicey, it teleports away.
name: Cosmog

flavor_text: This Pokémon can be spotted in wall paintingsfrom as far back as 10,000 years ago. For awhile, it was thought to have gone extinct.
name: Mamoswine

flavor_text: It looks strong, and that’s exactly what it is.As the weather grows colder, its ice tusksgrow longer, thicker, and more impressive.
name: Mamoswine

flavor_text: It observes prey while hanginginverted from branches. When thechance presents itself, it swoops!
name: Gliscor

flavor_text: Any frontal attack is repulsed.It is a docile Pokémon thatfeeds on grass and berries.
name: Bastiodon

flavor_text: A Pokémon that lived in junglesaround 100 million years ago. Itsfacial hide is extremely hard.
name: Shieldon

flavor_text: When BURMY evolved, its cloakbecame a part of this Pokémon’sbody. The cloak is never shed.
name: Wormadam

flavor_text: To shelter itself from cold, wintrywinds, it covers itself with a cloakmade of twigs and leaves.
name: Burmy

flavor_text: The members of the trio spend all their timetogether. Each one has a slightly different tastein nectar.
name: Combee

flavor_text: It ceaselessly gathers nectar from sunrise tosundown, all for the sake of Vespiquen andthe swarm.
name: Combee

flavor_text: It loves the honey of flowersand steals honey collected byCOMBEE.
name: Mothim

flavor_text: It makes fur balls that cracklewith static electricity. It storesthem with berries in tree holes.
name: Pachirisu

flavor_text: It skillfully commands its grubs in battles with itsenemies. The grubs are willing to risk their livesto defend Vespiquen.
name: Vespiquen

flavor_text: Vespiquen that give off more pheromoneshave larger swarms of Combee attendants.
name: Vespiquen

flavor_text: It floats using its well-developedflotation sac. It assists in therescues of drowning people.
name: Floatzel

flavor_text: It has a flotation sac that islike an inflatable collar. It floatson water with its head out.
name: Buizel

flavor_text: Smart enough to use tools in battle, thesePokémon have been seen picking up rocks andflinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.
name: Corvisquire

flavor_text: The lessons of many harsh battles have taught ithow to accurately judge an opponent’s strength.
name: Corvisquire

flavor_text: At the end of its life-span, Melmetal will rust andfall apart. The small shards left behind willeventually be reborn as Meltan.
name: Melmetal

flavor_text: Centrifugal force is behind the punches ofMelmetal’s heavy hex-nut arms. Melmetal is saidto deliver the strongest punches of all Pokémon.
name: Melmetal

flavor_text: A constant collector of information, this Pokémonis very smart. Very strong is what it isn’t.
name: Blipbug

flavor_text: Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairson its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.
name: Blipbug

flavor_text: It barely moves, but it’s still alive. Hiding in itsshell without food or water seems to haveawakened its psychic powers.
name: Dottler

flavor_text: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychicabilities to monitor the outside world andprepare for evolution.
name: Dottler

flavor_text: It’s famous for its high level of intelligence, andthe large size of its brain is proof that it alsopossesses immense psychic power.
name: Orbeetle

flavor_text: It emits psychic energy to observe and studywhat’s around it—and what’s around it caninclude things over six miles away.
name: Orbeetle

flavor_text: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raidsthe food stores of other Pokémon. It survives offits ill-gotten gains.
name: Nickit

flavor_text: Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives bystealing food from others. It erases its tracks withswipes of its tail as it makes off with its plunder.
name: Nickit

flavor_text: This highly territorial Pokémon prefers dryclimates. It won’t come out of its boulder onrainy days.
name: Crustle

flavor_text: Its thick claws are its greatest weapons.They’re mighty enough to crackRhyperior’s carapace.
name: Crustle

flavor_text: If it locks eyes with you, watch out! Nothing andno one is safe from the reckless headbutts of thistroublesome Pokémon.
name: Scraggy

flavor_text: It protects itself with its durable skin. It’s thoughtthat this Pokémon will evolve once its skin hascompletely stretched out.
name: Scraggy

flavor_text: It runs as fast as lightning strikes, shredding itsopponents with its high-voltage claws.
name: Zeraora

flavor_text: Electricity sparks from the pads on its limbs.Wherever Zeraora runs, lightning flashes andthunder echoes.
name: Zeraora

flavor_text: Anglers love the fight this Pokémon puts up onthe hook. And there are always more to catch—many people release them into lakes illicitly.
name: Basculin

flavor_text: In the past, it often appeared on the dinnertable. The meat of red-striped Basculin is on thefatty side, and it’s more popular with the youth.
name: Basculin

flavor_text: The desert gets cold at night, so when the sunsets, this Pokémon burrows deep into the sandand sleeps until sunrise.
name: Sandile

flavor_text: Sandile is small, but its legs and lower body arepowerful. Pushing sand aside as it goes, Sandilemoves through the desert as if it’s swimming.
name: Sandile

flavor_text: Horsea makes its home in oceans with gentlecurrents. If this Pokémon is under attack, it spitsout pitch-black ink and escapes.
name: Horsea

flavor_text: They swim with dance-like motions and causewhirlpools to form. Horsea compete to see whichof them can generate the biggest whirlpool.
name: Horsea

flavor_text: This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sands.Krookodile’s mighty jaws can bite through heavyplates of iron with almost no effort at all.
name: Krookodile

flavor_text: While terribly aggressive, Krookodile also hasthe patience to stay hidden under sand for days,lying in wait for prey.
name: Krookodile

flavor_text: It derives its power from fire burning insideits body. If the fire dwindles, this Pokémon willimmediately fall asleep.
name: Darumaka

flavor_text: This popular symbol of good fortune will neverfall over in its sleep, no matter how it’s pushedor pulled.
name: Darumaka

flavor_text: The thick arms of this hot-blooded Pokémoncan deliver punches capable of obliterating adump truck.
name: Darmanitan

flavor_text: This Pokémon’s power level rises along with thetemperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500degrees Fahrenheit.
name: Darmanitan

flavor_text: With noises that could be mistaken for the rattlesof maracas, it creates an upbeat rhythm, startlingbird Pokémon and making them fly off in a hurry.
name: Maractus

flavor_text: Once each year, this Pokémon scatters its seeds.They’re jam-packed with nutrients, making thema precious food source out in the desert.
name: Maractus

flavor_text: When it finds a stone appealing, it creates a holeinside it and uses it as its home. This Pokémon isthe natural enemy of Roggenrola and Rolycoly.
name: Dwebble

flavor_text: It first tries to find a rock to live in, but if thereare no suitable rocks to be found, Dwebble maymove in to the ports of a Hippowdon.
name: Dwebble

flavor_text: When a storm approaches, this Pokémon getsrestless. Once Elekid hears the sound of thunder,it gets full-on rowdy.
name: Elekid

flavor_text: It’s not good at storing electricity yet. ThisPokémon sneaks into people’s homes, lookingfor electrical outlets to eat electricity from.
name: Elekid

flavor_text: If its face gets even slightly dirty, Smoochum willbathe immediately. But if its body gets dirty,Smoochum doesn’t really seem to care.
name: Smoochum

flavor_text: This is a very curious Pokémon. Smoochumdecides what it likes and dislikes by touchingthings with its lips.
name: Smoochum

flavor_text: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each oneappears to be made up of many life-formsstacked one on top of each other.
name: Stakataka

flavor_text: Its venom sacs produce a fluid that thisPokémon then heats up with the flame in its tail.This process creates Salandit’s poisonous gas.
name: Salandit

flavor_text: This sneaky Pokémon will slink behind its preyand immobilize it with poisonous gas before theprey even realizes Salandit is there.
name: Salandit

flavor_text: It swings its longsnout around play­fully, but becauseit is so strong,that can be dan­gerous.
name: Phanpy

flavor_text: With the arrival of a storm at sea, this Pokémonwill show itself on the surface. When a Kingdraand a Dragonite meet, a fierce battle ensues.
name: Kingdra

flavor_text: Scales shed by this Pokémon have such asplendorous gleam to them that they’ve beengiven to royalty as gifts.
name: Kingdra

flavor_text: This is a Porygon that was updated with specialdata. Porygon2 develops itself by learning aboutmany different subjects all on its own.
name: Porygon2

flavor_text: After artificial intelligence was implemented inPorygon2, the Pokémon began using a strangelanguage that only other Porygon2 understand.
name: Porygon2

flavor_text: It has sharp, hardtusks and a ruggedhide. Its TACKLEis strong enoughto knock down ahouse.
name: Donphan

flavor_text: A special fluidoozes from the tipof its tail. Itpaints the fluideverywhere to markits territory.
name: Smeargle

flavor_text: The curved antlerssubtly change theflow of air tocreate a strangespace where real­ity is distorted.
name: Stantler

flavor_text: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at highspeed, it may bore its way into the ground.
name: Hitmontop

flavor_text: After doing a handstand to throw off theopponent’s timing, it presents its fancy kick moves.
name: Hitmontop

flavor_text: It is always bursting with energy. To make itselfstronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.
name: Tyrogue

flavor_text: Even though it is small, it can’t be ignored becauseit will slug any handy target without warning.
name: Tyrogue

flavor_text: One boy’s invention led to the development ofmany different machines that take advantage ofRotom’s unique capabilities.
name: Rotom

flavor_text: With a body made of plasma, it can inhabit allsorts of machines. It loves to surprise others.
name: Rotom

flavor_text: MIGHTYENA gives obvious signals whenit is preparing to attack. It starts togrowl deeply and then flattens its body.This POKéMON will bite savagely with itssharply pointed fangs.
name: Mightyena

flavor_text: After a woman met her end on a snowy mountain,her regrets lingered on. From them, this Pokémonwas born. Its favorite food is frozen souls.
name: Froslass

flavor_text: It spits out cold air of nearly −60 degreesFahrenheit to freeze its quarry. It brings frozenprey back to its lair and neatly lines them up.
name: Froslass

flavor_text: It marks its territory by rubbing its bristly fur ontrees. This variety of Zigzagoon is friendlier andcalmer than the kind native to Galar.
name: Zigzagoon

flavor_text: Zigzagoon that adapted to regions outsideGalar acquired this appearance. If you’ve lostsomething, this Pokémon can likely find it.
name: Zigzagoon

flavor_text: With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything.It did not originally live in Alola but wasimported from another region.
name: Yungoos

flavor_text: When it finds a trace of its prey, it patientlystakes out the location...but it’s always snoozingby nightfall.
name: Gumshoos

flavor_text: Its natural enemies, like Rookidee, mayflee rather than risk getting caught in its largemandibles that can snap thick tree branches.
name: Grubbin

flavor_text: It uses its big jaws to dig nests into the forestfloor, and it loves to feed on sweet tree sap.
name: Grubbin

flavor_text: While its durable shell protects it from attacks,Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts ofelectricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.
name: Charjabug
