flavor_text: Its digestive processes convert the leaves it eatsinto electricity. An electric sac in its belly storesthe electricity for later use.
name: Charjabug

flavor_text: With its mouth, it makes sonic waves that soundlike beautiful singing. It uses the sonic waves tocontrol its water balloons.
name: Primarina

flavor_text: For Primarina, every battle’s a stage. Its singingand the dancing of its balloons will mesmerizethe audience.
name: Primarina

flavor_text: SWAMPERT is very strong. It has enoughpower to easily drag a boulder weighingmore than a ton.This POKéMON also has powerful visionthat lets it see even in murky water.
name: Swampert

flavor_text: It eats berries and stores their seeds in itsbeak. When it encounters enemies or prey,it fires off all the seeds in a burst.
name: Trumbeak

flavor_text: When it battles, its beak heats up. Thetemperature can easily exceed 212 degreesFahrenheit, causing severe burns when it hits.
name: Toucannon

flavor_text: At first sight, POOCHYENA takes a biteat anything that moves.This POKéMON chases after prey untilthe victim becomes exhausted.However, it may turn tail if the preystrikes back.
name: Poochyena

flavor_text: It builds up electricity in its abdomen, focuses itthrough its jaws, and then fires the electricity offin concentrated beams.
name: Vikavolt

flavor_text: If it carries a Charjabug to use as a spare battery,a flying Vikavolt can rapidly fire high-poweredbeams of electricity.
name: Vikavolt

flavor_text: While guarding its weak points with its pincers,it looks for an opening and unleashes punches.When it loses, it foams at the mouth and faints.
name: Crabrawler

flavor_text: Its punches slice the air. They are launched atsuch high speed, even a slight graze could causea burn.
name: Hitmonchan

flavor_text: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems toneed a short break after fighting for three minutes.
name: Hitmonchan

flavor_text: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging.It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.
name: Electrike

flavor_text: It stores electricity in its fur. It gives off sparksfrom all over its body in seasons when the air is dry.
name: Electrike

flavor_text: It is said that through meditation,MEDICHAM heightens energy insideits body and sharpens its sixth sense.This POKéMON hides its presence bymerging itself with fields andmountains.
name: Medicham

flavor_text: This amazing Pokémon has an awesome sense ofbalance. It can kick in succession from any position.
name: Hitmonlee

flavor_text: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchylegs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.
name: Hitmonlee

flavor_text: Lairon live in mountains brimming with springwater and iron ore, so these Pokémon oftencame into conflict with humans in the past.
name: Lairon

flavor_text: During territorial disputes, Lairon fight byslamming into each other. Close inspection oftheir steel armor reveals scratches and dents.
name: Lairon

flavor_text: It eats iron ore—and sometimes railroad tracks—to build up the steel armor that protects its body.
name: Aron

flavor_text: When Aron evolves, its steel armor peels off. Inancient times, people would collect Aron’s shedarmor and make good use of it in their daily lives.
name: Aron

flavor_text: MEDITITE undertakes rigorous mentaltraining deep in the mountains.However, whenever it meditates, thisPOKéMON always loses its concentrationand focus. As a result, its trainingnever ends.
name: Meditite

flavor_text: Aggron has a horn sharp enough to perforatethick iron sheets. It brings down its opponents byramming into them horn first.
name: Aggron

flavor_text: Long ago, there was a king who wore a helmetmeant to resemble the head of an Aggron. Hewas trying to channel the Pokémon’s strength.
name: Aggron

flavor_text: DELCATTY prefers to live an unfetteredexistence in which it can do as itpleases at its own pace.Because this POKéMON eats and sleepswhenever it decides, its daily routinesare completely random.
name: Delcatty

flavor_text: SKITTY has the habit of becomingfascinated by moving objects andchasing them around.This POKéMON is known to chase afterits own tail and become dizzy.
name: Skitty

flavor_text: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes intocomplacency, then bites with its huge,relentless jaws.
name: Mawile

flavor_text: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws areactually steel horns that have been transformed.
name: Mawile

flavor_text: This Pokémon is feared. When its gemstone eyesbegin to glow with a sinister shine, it’s believedthat Sableye will steal people’s spirits away.
name: Sableye

flavor_text: It feeds on gemstone crystals. In darkness, itseyes sparkle with the glitter of jewels.
name: Sableye

flavor_text: Many power plants keep Ground-type Pokémonaround as a defense against Electabuzz thatcome seeking electricity.
name: Electabuzz

flavor_text: With the coming of a storm, many of thesePokémon will gather under tall trees and sit therewaiting for lightning to strike.
name: Electabuzz

flavor_text: In certain parts of Galar, Jynx was once fearedand worshiped as the Queen of Ice.
name: Jynx

flavor_text: The Jynx of Galar often have beautiful anddelicate voices. Some of these Pokémon haveeven gathered a fan base.
name: Jynx

flavor_text: These Pokémon judge one another based onpincers. Thicker, more impressive pincers makefor more popularity with the opposite gender.
name: Pinsir

flavor_text: This Pokémon clamps its pincers down on its preyand then either splits the prey in half or flingsit away.
name: Pinsir

flavor_text: Magmar dispatches its prey with fire. But itregrets this habit once it realizes that it hasburned its intended prey to a charred crisp.
name: Magmar

flavor_text: These Pokémon’s bodies are constantly burning.Magmar are feared as one of the causesbehind fires.
name: Magmar

flavor_text: This Pokémon has an organ known as its core.The organ glows in seven colors when Starmie isunleashing its potent psychic powers.
name: Starmie

flavor_text: Starmie swims by spinning its body at high speed.As this Pokémon cruises through the ocean, itabsorbs tiny plankton.
name: Starmie

flavor_text: Its body is solid muscle. When swimming throughcold seas, Poliwrath uses its impressive arms tosmash through drift ice and plow forward.
name: Poliwrath

flavor_text: Poliwrath is skilled at both swimming and martialarts. It uses its well-trained arms to dish outpowerful punches.
name: Poliwrath

flavor_text: As Scyther fights more and more battles, itsscythes become sharper and sharper. With asingle slice, Scyther can fell a massive tree.
name: Scyther

flavor_text: If you come across an area in a forest where a lotof the trees have been cut down, what you’vefound is a Scyther’s territory.
name: Scyther

flavor_text: The broadness of its hands may be nocoincidence—many scientists believe its palmsbecame enlarged specifically for pantomiming.
name: Mr. Mime

flavor_text: It’s known for its top-notch pantomime skills.It protects itself from all sorts of attacks byemitting auras from its fingers to create walls.
name: Mr. Mime

flavor_text: Each of Exeggutor’s three heads is thinkingdifferent thoughts. The three don’t seem to bevery interested in one another.
name: Exeggutor

flavor_text: When they work together, Exeggutor’s threeheads can put out powerful psychic energy.Cloudy days make this Pokémon sluggish.
name: Exeggutor

flavor_text: It is virtually worthless in terms of both powerand speed. It is the most weak and patheticPokémon in the world.
name: Magikarp

flavor_text: This weak and pathetic Pokémon gets easilypushed along rivers when there are strong currents.
name: Magikarp

flavor_text: When Tauros begins whipping itself with its tails,it’s a warning that the Pokémon is about tocharge with astounding speed.
name: Tauros

flavor_text: The Tauros of the Galar region are volatile innature, and they won’t allow people to ride ontheir backs.
name: Tauros

flavor_text: A carnivorousPOKéMON that trapsand eats bugs.It uses its rootfeet to soak upneeded moisture.
name: Bellsprout

flavor_text: It quickly swings its four arms to rock itsopponents with ceaseless punches and chopsfrom all angles.
name: Machamp

flavor_text: With four arms that react more quickly than itcan think, it can execute many punches at once.
name: Machamp

flavor_text: CASCOON makes its protective cocoonby wrapping its body entirely with afine silk from its mouth. Once the silkgoes around its body, it hardens.This POKéMON prepares for its evolutioninside the cocoon.
name: Cascoon

flavor_text: Venipede and Sizzlipede are similar species,but when the two meet, a huge fight ensues.
name: Venipede

flavor_text: Its fangs are highly venomous. If this Pokémonfinds prey it thinks it can eat, it leaps for themwithout any thought of how things might turn out.
name: Venipede

flavor_text: DUSTOX is instinctively drawn to light.Swarms of this POKéMON are attractedby the bright lights of cities, wherethey wreak havoc by stripping theleaves off roadside trees for food.
name: Dustox

flavor_text: If you see a Sawk training in the mountains in itssingle-minded pursuit of strength, it’s best toquietly pass by.
name: Sawk

flavor_text: The karate chops of a Sawk that’s trained itselfto the limit can cleave the ocean itself.
name: Sawk

flavor_text: When Klang goes all out, the minigear links upperfectly with the outer part of the big gear, andthis Pokémon’s rotation speed increases sharply.
name: Klang

flavor_text: Many companies in the Galar region chooseKlang as their logo. This Pokémon is consideredthe symbol of industrial technology.
name: Klang

flavor_text: From its spikes, it launches powerful blasts ofelectricity. Its red core contains an enormousamount of energy.
name: Klinklang

flavor_text: The three gears that compose this Pokémonspin at high speed. Its new spiked gear isn’ta living creature.
name: Klinklang

flavor_text: While one alone doesn’t have much power,a chain of many Tynamo can be aspowerful as lightning.
name: Tynamo

flavor_text: They coil around foes and shock themwith electricity-generating organs thatseem simply to be circular patterns.
name: Eelektrik

flavor_text: They crawl out of the ocean using theirarms. They will attack prey on shore andimmediately drag it into the ocean.
name: Eelektross

flavor_text: If this Pokémon stands near a TV, strange scenerywill appear on the screen. That scenery is saidto be from its home.
name: Elgyem

flavor_text: This Pokémon was discovered about 50 yearsago. Its highly developed brain enables it toexert its psychic powers.
name: Elgyem

flavor_text: Whenever a Beheeyem visits a farm,a Dubwool mysteriously disappears.
name: Beheeyem

flavor_text: Sometimes found drifting above wheat fields,this Pokémon can control the memories ofits opponents.
name: Beheeyem

flavor_text: The flame on its head keeps its body slightlywarm. This Pokémon takes lost children by thehand to guide them to the spirit world.
name: Litwick

flavor_text: The younger the life this Pokémon absorbs,the brighter and eerier the flame on itshead burns.
name: Litwick

flavor_text: This Pokémon appears just before someonepasses away, so it’s feared as an emissaryof death.
name: Lampent

flavor_text: It lurks in cities, pretending to be a lamp.Once it finds someone whose death is near,it will trail quietly after them.
name: Lampent

name: Chandelure

flavor_text: In homes illuminated by Chandelure instead oflights, funerals were a constant occurrence—or so it’s said.
name: Chandelure

flavor_text: When bathed in sunlight, this Pokémon emits apleasantly sweet scent, which causes bugPokémon to gather around it.
name: Fomantis

flavor_text: During the day, Fomantis basks in sunlight andsleeps peacefully. It wakes and moves aroundat night.
name: Fomantis

flavor_text: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them toberries it’s decorated with cream.
name: Alcremie

flavor_text: When Alcremie is content, the cream itsecretes from its hands becomes sweeterand richer.
name: Alcremie

flavor_text: It’s believed that even first-rate gardeners have ahard time getting the flower on a Lilligant’s headto bloom.
name: Lilligant

flavor_text: Essential oils made from Lilligant flowershave a sublime scent, but they’re alsostaggeringly expensive.
name: Lilligant

flavor_text: Petilil appears around sources of clean water.Boiling leaves from this Pokémon’s head results ina liquid that’s sometimes used as a bug repellent.
name: Petilil

flavor_text: The deeper the color of a Petilil’s leaves, thehealthier the Pokémon is. Petilil sometimes makesits home in a well-tended field or flowerbed.
name: Petilil

flavor_text: There are a slew of stories about villages thatwere destroyed by Hydreigon. It bites anythingthat moves.
name: Hydreigon

flavor_text: The three heads take turns sinking their teeth intothe opponent. Their attacks won’t slow until theirtarget goes down.
name: Hydreigon

flavor_text: A powerful curse was woven into an ancientpainting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask,the painting began to move.
name: Runerigus

flavor_text: Never touch its shadowlike body, or you’ll beshown the horrific memories behind the picturecarved into it.
name: Runerigus

flavor_text: It agilely scales sheer cliffs tolive atop craggy mountains. Itsfire is put out when it sleeps.
name: Chimchar

flavor_text: While hunting for prey, Zweilous wanders itsterritory, its two heads often bickering overwhich way to go.
name: Zweilous

flavor_text: Their two heads will fight each other over asingle piece of food. Zweilous are covered inscars even without battling others.
name: Zweilous

flavor_text: To intimidate attackers, itstretches the fire on its tailto make itself appear bigger.
name: Monferno

flavor_text: Volcarona scatters burning scales. Some say itdoes this to start fires. Others say it’s trying torescue those that suffer in the cold.
name: Volcarona

flavor_text: This Pokémon emerges from a cocoon formed ofraging flames. Ancient murals depict Volcarona asa deity of fire.
name: Volcarona

flavor_text: The people of ancient times believed thatLarvesta fell from the sun.
name: Larvesta

flavor_text: Larvesta’s body is warm all over. It spouts firefrom the tips of its horns to intimidate predatorsand scare prey.
name: Larvesta

flavor_text: There’s a hole in its tail that allows it to draw inthe air it needs to keep its fire burning. If thehole gets blocked, this Pokémon will fall ill.
name: Heatmor

flavor_text: A flame serves as its tongue, melting through thehard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devourtheir insides.
name: Heatmor

flavor_text: Although it’s a bit of a ruffian, this Pokémon willtake lost Vullaby under its wing and care for themtill they’re ready to leave the nest.
name: Mandibuzz

flavor_text: They adorn themselves with bones. There seemto be fashion trends among them, as differentbones come into and fall out of popularity.
name: Mandibuzz

flavor_text: When it encounters something, its first urge isusually to bite it. If it likes what it tastes, it willcommit the associated scent to memory.
name: Deino

flavor_text: Because it can’t see, this Pokémon is constantlybiting at everything it touches, trying to keeptrack of its surroundings.
name: Deino

flavor_text: They lay their eggs deep inside their nests.When attacked by Heatmor, they retaliateusing their massive mandibles.
name: Durant

flavor_text: With their large mandibles, these Pokémon cancrunch their way through rock. They worktogether to protect their eggs from Sandaconda.
name: Durant

flavor_text: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smellingparticles in the air. Its body is made of cream.
name: Milcery

flavor_text: They say that any patisserie visited by Milceryis guaranteed success and good fortune.
name: Milcery

flavor_text: It has a savage nature. It willcourageously challenge foes thatare much larger.
name: Staraptor

flavor_text: Its shell is overflowing with its heightenedotherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves asprotection for this Pokémon’s core spirit.
name: Cursola

flavor_text: Be cautious of the ectoplasmic bodysurrounding its soul. You’ll becomestiff as stone if you touch it.
name: Cursola

flavor_text: Only Farfetch’d that have survived many battlescan attain this evolution. When this Pokémon’sleek withers, it will retire from combat.
name: Sirfetch’d

flavor_text: After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield,it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk. The leekstalk is both weapon and food.
name: Sirfetch’d

flavor_text: It’s highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its caneof ice in time with its graceful movements.
name: Mr. Rime

flavor_text: Its amusing movements make it very popular.It releases its psychic power from the patternon its belly.
name: Mr. Rime

flavor_text: With nerves of steel, nothing canperturb it. It is more agile andactive than it appears.
name: Bidoof

flavor_text: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg forforgiveness, it’s trying to lure opponents in sothat it can stab them with its spear-like hair.

flavor_text: With sly cunning, it tries to lure people into thewoods. Some believe it to have the power tomake crops grow.
name: Morgrem

flavor_text: Its hairs work like muscle fibers. When its hairsunfurl, they latch on to opponents, ensnaringthem as tentacles would.
name: Grimmsnarl

flavor_text: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoonhas a tendency to take on a threatening postureand shout—this move is known as Obstruct.

flavor_text: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights.While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout thatwould make any opponent flinch.
name: Obstagoon

name: Perrserker

flavor_text: After many battles, it evolved dangerousclaws that come together to form daggerswhen extended.
name: Perrserker

name: Chimecho

name: Musharna

flavor_text: It drowses and dreams all the time. It’s best toleave it be if it’s just woken up, as it’s a terriblegrump when freshly roused from sleep.
name: Musharna

flavor_text: Where people go, these Pokémon follow.If you’re scattering food for them, be careful—several hundred of them can gather at once.
name: Pidove

flavor_text: It’s forgetful and not very bright, but manyTrainers love it anyway for its friendlinessand sincerity.
name: Pidove

flavor_text: It loves sweets because they becomeenergy for the fire burning insideits body.
name: Simisear

flavor_text: The water stored inside the tuft onits head is full of nutrients. Plantsthat receive its water grow large.
name: Panpour

flavor_text: The tuft on its head holds water. Whenthe level runs low, it replenishes thetuft by siphoning up water with its tail.
name: Simipour

name: Munna

flavor_text: It eats dreams and releases mist. The mist is pinkwhen it’s eating a good dream, and black whenit’s eating a nightmare.
name: Munna

flavor_text: Don’t be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegantfigure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.
name: Liepard

flavor_text: This stealthy Pokémon sneaks up behind preywithout making any sound at all. It competes withThievul for territory.
name: Liepard

flavor_text: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest.Eating a leaf from its head whisksweariness away as if by magic.
name: Pansage

flavor_text: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging itsbarbed tail around wildly. The leafgrowing on its head is very bitter.
name: Simisage

flavor_text: When it is angered, the temperatureof its head tuft reaches 600° F.It uses its tuft to roast berries.
name: Pansear

flavor_text: Individually, they’re incredibly weak. It’s bygathering up into schools that they’re ableto confront opponents.
name: Wishiwashi

flavor_text: When it senses danger, its eyes tear up.The sparkle of its tears signals otherWishiwashi to gather.
name: Wishiwashi

flavor_text: No matter how dirty the water in the river, it willadapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.
name: Corphish

flavor_text: It was originally a Pokémon from afar that escapedto the wild. It can adapt to the dirtiest river.
name: Corphish

flavor_text: It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks,it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.
name: Shuckle

flavor_text: The berries stored in its vaselike shell eventuallybecome a thick, pulpy juice.
name: Shuckle

flavor_text: It moves while spinning around on its single foot.Some Baltoy have been seen spinning ontheir heads.
name: Baltoy

flavor_text: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving,it constantly spins. It stands on one foot evenwhen asleep.
name: Baltoy

flavor_text: A rough customer that wildly flails its giant claws.It is said to be extremely hard to raise.
name: Crawdaunt

flavor_text: A brutish Pokémon that loves to battle. It willcrash itself into any foe that approaches its nest.
name: Crawdaunt

flavor_text: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil.Lileep once lived in warm seas that existedapproximately 100,000,000 years ago.
name: Lileep

flavor_text: Lileep clings to rocks on the seabed. When preycomes close, this Pokémon entangles it withpetallike tentacles.
name: Lileep

flavor_text: This mysterious Pokémon started life as an ancientclay figurine made over 20,000 years ago.
name: Claydol

flavor_text: It appears to have been born from clay dollsmade by ancient people. It uses telekinesis tofloat and move.
name: Claydol

flavor_text: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil.Anorith lived in the ocean about 100,000,000years ago, hunting with its pair of claws.
name: Anorith

flavor_text: Anorith can swim swiftly by pulling its eight wingsthrough the water like oars on a boat. ThisPokémon is an ancestor of modern bug Pokémon.
name: Anorith

flavor_text: Bulky pincers account for one third of Scizor’sbody weight. A single swing of one of thesepincers will crush a boulder completely.
name: Scizor

flavor_text: Though its body is slim, Scizor has tremendousattacking power. Even Scizor’s muscles are madeof metal.
name: Scizor

flavor_text: Although unattractive and unpopular, thisPokémon’s marvelous vitality has made it asubject of research.
name: Feebas

flavor_text: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it isvery hardy and can survive on little water.
name: Feebas

flavor_text: After evolution, this Pokémon emerged ontoland. Its lower body has become stronger, andblows from its tail are devastating.
name: Armaldo

flavor_text: Though it lives on land, it’s also a good swimmer.It dives into the ocean in search of prey, using itssharp claws to take down its quarry.
name: Armaldo

flavor_text: The male with the largest mane of fireis the leader of the pride.
name: Pyroar

flavor_text: These Pokémon are never seen anywhere nearconflict or turmoil. In recent times, they’ve hardlybeen seen at all.
name: Togekiss

flavor_text: Known as a bringer of blessings, it’sbeen depicted on good-luck charmssince ancient times.
name: Togekiss

flavor_text: By churning its wings, it createsshock waves that inflict criticalinternal injuries to foes.
name: Yanmega

flavor_text: Swanna start to dance at dusk.The one dancing in the middle isthe leader of the flock.
name: Swanna

flavor_text: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers.They swim around in the water eatingtheir favorite food--peat moss.
name: Ducklett

flavor_text: As Emolga flutters through the air, it crackleswith electricity. This Pokémon is cute, but it cancause a lot of trouble.
name: Emolga

flavor_text: This Pokémon absolutely loves sweet berries.Sometimes it stuffs its cheeks full of so muchfood that it can’t fly properly.
name: Emolga

flavor_text: They migrate according to the seasons.People can tell the season by looking atSawsbuck’s horns.
name: Sawsbuck

flavor_text: The color and scent of their fur changesto match the mountain grass. When theysense hostility, they hide in the grass.
name: Deerling

flavor_text: When its anger reaches a breaking point, thisPokémon unleashes a fierce blizzard that freezesevery creature around it, be they friend or foe.
name: Vanilluxe

flavor_text: People believe this Pokémon formed when twoVanillish stuck together. Its body temperature isroughly 21 degrees Fahrenheit.
name: Vanilluxe

flavor_text: If it sees any packs of Darumaka going afterSnover, it chases them off, swinging its sizablearms like hammers.
name: Abomasnow

flavor_text: This Pokémon is known to bring blizzards.A shake of its massive body is enough tocause whiteout conditions.
name: Abomasnow

flavor_text: They attack their quarry in packs. Prey as largeas Mamoswine easily fall to the teamwork ofa group of Weavile.
name: Weavile

flavor_text: With its claws, it leaves behind signs for itsfriends to find. The number of distinct signsis said to be over 500.
name: Weavile

flavor_text: Some say that Magnezone receives signals fromspace via the antenna on its head and that it’sbeing controlled by some mysterious being.
name: Magnezone

flavor_text: It’s thought that a special magnetic field changedthe molecular structure of this Pokémon’s body,and that’s what caused the Pokémon’s evolution.
name: Magnezone

flavor_text: Lickilicky’s strange tongue can stretch to manytimes the length of its body. No one has figuredout how Lickilicky’s tongue can stretch so far.
name: Lickilicky

flavor_text: Lickilicky can do just about anything with itstongue, which is as dexterous as the human hand.In contrast, Lickilicky’s use of its fingers is clumsy.
name: Lickilicky

flavor_text: It can load up to three projectiles per arm intothe holes in its hands. What launches out of thoseholes could be either rocks or Roggenrola.
name: Rhyperior

flavor_text: It relies on its carapace to deflect incomingattacks and throw its enemy off balance. As soonas that happens, it drives its drill into the foe.
name: Rhyperior

flavor_text: Tangrowth has two arms that it can extend as itpleases. Recent research has shown that thesearms are, in fact, bundles of vines.
name: Tangrowth

flavor_text: Vine growth is accelerated for Tangrowth living inwarm climates. If the vines grow long, Tangrowthshortens them by tearing parts of them off.
name: Tangrowth

flavor_text: The amount of electrical energy this Pokémonproduces is proportional to the rate of its pulse.The voltage jumps while Electivire is battling.
name: Electivire

flavor_text: In terms of electrical-energy output, Electivireis one of the best among all Electric Pokémon.It discharges high-voltage currents from its tails.
name: Electivire

flavor_text: When Magmortar inhales deeply, the fire burningin its belly intensifies, rising in temperature toover 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.
name: Magmortar

flavor_text: Living in the crater of a volcano has caused thisPokémon’s body to resemble its environment—it has an organ similar to a magma chamber.
name: Magmortar

flavor_text: Both of its legs have turned into wings. Without asound, Crobat flies swiftly toward its prey andsinks its fangs into the nape of its target’s neck.
name: Crobat

flavor_text: This Pokémon flaps its four wings skillfully.Crobat can fly through cramped caves withoutneeding to slow down.
name: Crobat

flavor_text: Miltank produces highly nutritious milk, so it’sbeen supporting the lives of people and otherPokémon since ancient times.
name: Miltank

flavor_text: This Pokémon needs to be milked every day,or else it will fall ill. The flavor of Miltank milkchanges with the seasons.
name: Miltank

flavor_text: Whenever a Blissey finds a weakened Pokémon,it will share its egg and offer its care until theother Pokémon is all better.
name: Blissey

flavor_text: Blissey lays mysterious eggs that are filled withhappiness. It’s said that anyone who eats aBlissey egg will start acting kindly to all others.
name: Blissey

flavor_text: The rain clouds itcarries let itfire thunderboltsat will. They saythat it descendedwith lightning.
name: Raikou

flavor_text: Volcanoes eruptwhen it barks. Un­able to restrainits extreme power,it races headlongaround the land.
name: Entei

flavor_text: Said to be thereincarnation ofnorth winds, itcan instantlypurify filthy,murky water.
name: Suicune

flavor_text: Born deep underground, it comesaboveground and becomes a pupa once ithas finished eating the surrounding soil.
name: Larvitar

flavor_text: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a largemountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.
name: Larvitar

flavor_text: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely.Hard and fast, it has outstandingdestructive power.
name: Pupitar

flavor_text: It will not stay still, even while it’s a pupa.It already has arms and legs under its solid shell.
name: Pupitar

flavor_text: Its body can’t be harmed by any sort of attack,so it is very eager to make challengesagainst enemies.
name: Tyranitar

flavor_text: The quakes caused when it walks make evengreat mountains crumble and changethe surrounding terrain.
name: Tyranitar

flavor_text: It is said that itquietly spends itstime deep at thebottom of the seabecause its powersare too strong.
name: Lugia

flavor_text: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet sofast, the movement can rarely be seen.
name: Hoothoot

flavor_text: It begins to hoot at the same time every day.Some Trainers use them in place of clocks.
name: Hoothoot

flavor_text: It makes a nest tosuit its long andskinny body. Thenest is impossiblefor other POKéMONto enter.
name: Furret

flavor_text: It is very timid.It will be afraidto move if it isalone. But it willbe active if it isin a group.
name: Ledyba

flavor_text: Its eyes are specially developed to enable it tosee clearly even in murky darkness and minimal light.
name: Noctowl

flavor_text: When it needs to think, it rotates its head180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.
name: Noctowl

flavor_text: It lies still inthe same pose fordays in its web,waiting for itsunsuspecting preyto wander close.
name: Spinarak

flavor_text: When the starsflicker in thenight sky, itflutters about,scattering aglowing powder.
name: Ledian

flavor_text: Fletchinder launches embers into the den ofits prey. When the prey comes leaping out,Fletchinder’s sharp talons finish it off.
name: Fletchinder

flavor_text: Fletchinder are exceedingly territorial andaggressive. These Pokémon fight amongthemselves over feeding grounds.
name: Fletchinder

flavor_text: Talonflame mainly preys upon other birdPokémon. To intimidate opponents, it sendsembers spewing from gaps between its feathers.
name: Talonflame

flavor_text: Talonflame dives toward prey at speeds of up to310 mph and assaults them with powerful kicks,giving the prey no chance to escape.
name: Talonflame

flavor_text: The shell on itsback is just skinthat has cooledand hardened. Itbreaks easily witha slight touch.
name: Magcargo

flavor_text: When the interior part of its tail spins like amotor, Zekrom can generate many bolts oflightning to blast its surroundings.
name: Zekrom

flavor_text: Mythology tells us that if people lose therighteousness in their hearts, their kingdomswill be razed by Zekrom’s lightning.
name: Zekrom

flavor_text: Lands visited by Landorus grant suchbountiful crops that it has been hailedas “The Guardian of the Fields.”
name: Landorus

flavor_text: Dwelling within it is a power even greater thanthat of Reshiram or Zekrom, but the extremecold keeps that power bound.
name: Kyurem

flavor_text: It appears that this Pokémon uses its powers overice to freeze its own body in order to stabilize itscellular structure.
name: Kyurem

flavor_text: It never sleeps.It has to keepmoving because ifit stopped, itsmagma body wouldcool and harden.
name: Slugma

flavor_text: A legend tells of this Pokémon workingtogether with Cobalion and Terrakion toprotect the Pokémon of the Unova region.
name: Virizion

flavor_text: It darts around opponents with a flurry of quickmovements, slicing them up with its horns.
name: Virizion

flavor_text: The lower half of its body is wrapped ina cloud of energy. It zooms throughthe sky at 200 mph.
name: Tornadus

flavor_text: Countless charred remains mar thelandscape of places through whichThundurus has passed.
name: Thundurus

flavor_text: Flames spew from its tail as it flies through thesky like a jet airplane. It’s said that this Pokémonwill scorch the world.
name: Reshiram

flavor_text: According to myth, if people ignore truth andlet themselves become consumed by greed,Reshiram will arrive to burn their kingdoms down.
name: Reshiram

flavor_text: Vivillon with many different patterns arefound all over the world. These patternsare affected by the climate of their habitat.
name: Vivillon

flavor_text: It has a twig stuck in its tail. Withfriction from its tail fur, it sets thetwig on fire and launches into battle.
name: Braixen

flavor_text: Its melodies are sung with a specialvocalization method that can controlthe feelings of those who hear it.
name: Meloetta

flavor_text: Over 300 million years ago, it was fearedas the strongest of hunters.It has been modified by Team Plasma.
name: Genesect

flavor_text: The stronger the opponent it faces,the more heat surges from its maneand the more power flows through its body.
name: Litleo

flavor_text: It’s capable of flying faster than 120 mph.It battles alongside Dreepy anddotes on them until they successfully evolve.
name: Drakloak

flavor_text: Without a Dreepy to place on its head andcare for, it gets so uneasy it’ll try to substituteany Pokémon it finds for the missing Dreepy.
name: Drakloak

flavor_text: When it isn’t battling, it keeps Dreepy in theholes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launchesthe Dreepy like supersonic missiles.
name: Dragapult

flavor_text: Apparently the Dreepy inside Dragapult’shorns eagerly look forward to being launched outat Mach speeds.
name: Dragapult

flavor_text: Its body resembles polished metal, and it’s bothlightweight and strong. The only drawback is thatit rusts easily.
name: Duraludon

flavor_text: The special metal that composes its body is verylight, so this Pokémon has considerable agility.It lives in caves because it dislikes the rain.
name: Duraludon

flavor_text: By drumming, it taps into the power of its specialtree stump. The roots of the stump follow itsdirection in battle.
name: Rillaboom

flavor_text: The one with the best drumming techniquesbecomes the boss of the troop. It has a gentledisposition and values harmony among its group.
name: Rillaboom

flavor_text: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predatorof its time. Its own overhunting of its prey waswhat drove it to extinction.
name: Dracovish

flavor_text: Its mighty legs are capable of running atspeeds exceeding 40 mph, but this Pokémoncan’t breathe unless it’s underwater.
name: Dracovish

flavor_text: When under attack from bird Pokémon,it spews a poisonous black powderthat causes paralysis on contact.
name: Scatterbug

flavor_text: Grudges of the dead have possessed a mound ofsand and become a Pokémon. Sandygast is fondof the shovel on its head.
name: Sandygast

flavor_text: Sandygast mainly inhabits beaches. It takescontrol of anyone who puts their hand into itsmouth, forcing them to make its body bigger.
name: Sandygast

flavor_text: It will do anything to win, taking advantage ofevery opening and finishing opponents off withthe small claws on its front legs.
name: Golisopod

flavor_text: They live in sunken ships or in holes in theseabed. When Golisopod and Grapploctbattle, the loser becomes the winner’s meal.
name: Golisopod

flavor_text: It’s nature’s cleaner—it eats anything andeverything, including garbage and rotten things.The ground near its nest is always clean.
name: Wimpod

flavor_text: Wimpod gather in swarms, constantly on thelookout for danger. They scatter the momentthey detect an enemy’s presence.
name: Wimpod

flavor_text: Displaying amazing teamwork, they follow theorders of their boss as they all help out in thesearch for their favorite berries.
name: Passimian

flavor_text: Passimian live in groups of about 20, witheach member performing an assigned role.Through cooperation, the group survives.
name: Passimian

flavor_text: With waves of its fan—made from leaves and itsown fur—Oranguru skillfully gives instructions toother Pokémon.
name: Oranguru

flavor_text: It knows the forest inside and out. If it comesacross a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru willgather medicinal herbs to treat it.
name: Oranguru

flavor_text: It lives hidden within thicket shadows.When predators attack, it quickly bristles the furcovering its body in an effort to threaten them.
name: Spewpa

flavor_text: This feared Pokémon has long, slender legs anda cruel heart. It shows no mercy as it stomps onits opponents.
name: Tsareena

flavor_text: A kick from the hardened tips of this Pokémon’slegs leaves a wound in the opponent’s body andsoul that will never heal.
name: Tsareena

flavor_text: As it twirls like a dancer, a sweet smell spreadsout around it. Anyone who inhales the scent willfeel a surge of happiness.
name: Steenee

flavor_text: Any Corvisquire that pecks at thisPokémon will be greeted with a smack fromits sepals followed by a sharp kick.
name: Steenee

flavor_text: Its body gives off a sweet, fruity scent that isextremely appetizing to bird Pokémon.
name: Bounsweet

flavor_text: When under attack, it secretes a sweetand delicious sweat. The scent only callsmore enemies to it.
name: Bounsweet

flavor_text: Once it accepts you as a friend, it tries to showits affection with a hug. Letting it do that isdangerous—it could easily shatter your bones.
name: Bewear

flavor_text: The moves it uses to take down its prey wouldmake a martial artist jealous. It tucks subduedprey under its arms to carry them to its nest.
name: Bewear

flavor_text: Only female Salazzle exist. They emit a gas ladenwith pheromones to captivate male Salandit.
name: Salazzle

flavor_text: The winner of competitions between Salazzleis decided by which one has the most maleSalandit with it.
name: Salazzle

flavor_text: It lives in warm, shallow waters. If it encounters afoe, it will spit out its internal organs as a meansto punch them.
name: Pyukumuku

flavor_text: It’s covered in a slime that keeps its skin moist,allowing it to stay on land for days withoutdrying up.
name: Pyukumuku

flavor_text: It is said to live 1,000 years, and each of its tailsis loaded with supernatural powers.
name: Ninetales

flavor_text: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one ofits many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.
name: Ninetales

flavor_text: Jigglypuff has top-notch lung capacity, even bycomparison to other Pokémon. It won’t stopsinging its lullabies until its foes fall asleep.
name: Jigglypuff

flavor_text: By freely changing the wavelength of its voice,Jigglypuff sings a mysterious melody sure tomake any listener sleepy.
name: Jigglypuff

flavor_text: When it goes on a rampage, it’s impossible tocontrol. But in the presence of a Nidoqueen it’slived with for a long time, Nidoking calms down.
name: Nidoking

flavor_text: Nidoking prides itself on its strength. It’s forcefuland spirited in battle, making use of its thick tailand diamond-crushing horn.
name: Nidoking

flavor_text: It is said that happiness will come to those whosee a gathering of Clefairy dancing under afull moon.
name: Clefairy

flavor_text: Its adorable behavior and cry make it highly popular.However, this cute Pokémon is rarely found.
name: Clefairy

flavor_text: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it willrun and hide the moment it senses people.
name: Clefable

flavor_text: Their ears are sensitive enough to hear a pindrop from over a mile away, so they’re usuallyfound in quiet places.
name: Clefable

flavor_text: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When itgrows, several new tails are sprouted.
name: Vulpix

flavor_text: As each tail grows, its fur becomes more lustrous.When held, it feels slightly warm.
name: Vulpix

flavor_text: The horn on its head has atrophied. It’s thoughtthat this happens so Nidorina’s children won’t getpoked while their mother is feeding them.
name: Nidorina

flavor_text: If the group is threatened, these Pokémon willband together to assault enemies with a chorusof ultrasonic waves.
name: Nidorina

flavor_text: Nidoqueen is better at defense than offense.With scales like armor, this Pokémon will shieldits children from any kind of attack.
name: Nidoqueen

flavor_text: It pacifies offspring by placing them in the gapsbetween the spines on its back. The spines willnever secrete poison while young are present.
name: Nidoqueen

flavor_text: The horn on a male Nidoran’s forehead containsa powerful poison. This is a very cautiousPokémon, always straining its large ears.
name: Nidoran♂

flavor_text: Small but brave, this Pokémon will hold itsground and even risk its life in battle to protectthe female it’s friendly with.
name: Nidoran♂

flavor_text: With a horn that’s harder than diamond, thisPokémon goes around shattering boulders as itsearches for a moon stone.
name: Nidorino

flavor_text: It’s nervous and quick to act aggressively.The potency of its poison increases along withthe level of adrenaline present in its body.
name: Nidorino

flavor_text: It uses river stones to maintain the cutting edgesof the blades covering its body. These sharpenedblades allow it to bring down opponents.
name: Pawniard

flavor_text: A pack of these Pokémon forms to serve aBisharp boss. Each Pawniard trains diligently,dreaming of one day taking the lead.
name: Pawniard

flavor_text: It probes its surroundings with all its senses saveone—it doesn’t use its sense of sight. Spectrier’skicks are said to separate soul from body.
name: Spectrier

flavor_text: As it dashes through the night, Spectrier absorbsthe life-force of sleeping creatures. It cravessilence and solitude.
name: Spectrier

flavor_text: Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves.It’s also a belligerent Pokémon—anything itwants, it takes by force.
name: Glastrier

flavor_text: Glastrier has tremendous physical strength, andthe mask of ice covering its face is 100 timesharder than diamond.
name: Glastrier

flavor_text: It’s not uncommon for tunnels that appear tohave formed naturally to actually be a resultof Excadrill’s rampant digging.
name: Excadrill

flavor_text: Known as the Drill King, this Pokémon cantunnel through the terrain at speeds of over90 mph.
name: Excadrill

flavor_text: Kubfu trains hard to perfect its moves. The movesit masters will determine which form it takes whenit evolves.
name: Kubfu

flavor_text: If Kubfu pulls the long white hair on its head,its fighting spirit heightens and power wells upfrom the depths of its belly.
name: Kubfu

flavor_text: It throws one knifelike feather after another at itsenemies, and each one precisely strikes a weakpoint. These feathers are known as blade quills.
name: Dartrix

flavor_text: It never slacks when it comes to the task ofcleaning its feathers. Thorough preening keeps itlooking spiffy and its blade quills nice and sharp.
name: Dartrix

flavor_text: At a distance, it launches its sharp feathers whileflying about. If the enemy gets too close, Rowletswitches tactics and delivers vicious kicks.
name: Rowlet

flavor_text: During the day, it builds up energy viaphotosynthesis. At night, it flies silentlythrough the sky, on the prowl for prey.
name: Rowlet

flavor_text: It anchors itself in the ground with its single leg,then basks in the sun. After absorbing enoughsunlight, its petals spread as it blooms brilliantly.
name: Gossifleur

flavor_text: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyoussong. This delightful display has charmed manyinto raising this Pokémon.
name: Gossifleur

flavor_text: Comfey picks flowers with its vine and decoratesitself with them. For some reason, flowers won’twither once they’re attached to a Comfey.
name: Comfey

flavor_text: These Pokémon smell very nice. All Comfey weardifferent flowers, so each of these Pokémon hasits own individual scent.
name: Comfey

flavor_text: Calyrex is a merciful Pokémon, capable ofproviding healing and blessings. It reigned overthe Galar region in times of yore.
name: Calyrex

flavor_text: Calyrex is known in legend as a king that ruledover Galar in ancient times. It has the power tocause hearts to mend and plants to spring forth.
name: Calyrex

flavor_text: Loads weighing up to 50 times as much as itsown body weight pose no issue for this Pokémon.It’s skilled at making use of mud.
name: Mudbray

flavor_text: It eats dirt to create mud and smears this mud allover its feet, giving them the grip needed to walkon rough terrain without slipping.
name: Mudbray

flavor_text: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertipsthat can shoot water and a membrane on its backthat it can use to glide through the air.
name: Inteleon

flavor_text: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes’weak points so it can precisely blast them withwater that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.
name: Inteleon

flavor_text: As if dancing, it artfully dodges the attacks of itsenemies. All the while, it’s busy forming a bunchof balloons to overwhelm its foes.
name: Brionne

flavor_text: On nights when the sea is calm, Brionne dancewith one another to the singing of the Primarinathat’s leading them.
name: Brionne

flavor_text: The scent that constantly emits from its fur is sopowerful that this Pokémon’s companions willeventually lose their sense of smell.
name: Aromatisse

flavor_text: The scents Aromatisse can produce range fromsweet smells that bolster allies to foul smellsthat sap an opponent’s will to fight.
name: Aromatisse

flavor_text: Most of its body has the same composition ascoal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discoveredin coal mines about 400 years ago.
name: Rolycoly

flavor_text: It can race around like a unicycle, even on rough,rocky terrain. Burning coal sustains it.
name: Rolycoly

flavor_text: This Pokémon generates electricity and channelsit into its legs to keep them going strong.Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.
name: Boltund

flavor_text: It sends electricity through its legs to boost theirstrength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks50 mph.
name: Boltund

flavor_text: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dogin the Galar region. As it runs, it generateselectricity from the base of its tail.
name: Yamper

flavor_text: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people withtheir work because it wants treats. As it runs,it crackles with electricity.
name: Yamper

flavor_text: With jaws that can shear through steel rods,this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps downon its unfortunate prey.
name: Drednaw

flavor_text: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neckto sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies andtake them down.
name: Drednaw

flavor_text: Apparently the itch of its teething impels it tosnap its jaws at anything in front of it.
name: Chewtle

flavor_text: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hardhorn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, thisPokémon bites down and never lets go.
name: Chewtle

flavor_text: Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you endup with something closer to a trampoline. You’llstart to bounce the moment you set foot on it.
name: Dubwool

flavor_text: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress theopposite gender. They never see use in battle.
name: Dubwool

flavor_text: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion thatthis Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand rightback up at the bottom, unharmed.
name: Wooloo

flavor_text: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won’t beable to move. Cloth made with the wool of thisPokémon is surprisingly strong.
name: Wooloo

flavor_text: The seeds attached to its cotton fluff are full ofnutrients. It spreads them on the wind so thatplants and other Pokémon can benefit from them.
name: Eldegoss

flavor_text: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can bespun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galarregional specialty.
name: Eldegoss

flavor_text: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weavesclothing for it from leaves, using thecutters on its arms and sticky silk.
name: Leavanny

flavor_text: It’s usually peaceful, but the vandalism of minesenrages it. Offenders will be incinerated withflames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.
name: Coalossal

flavor_text: While it’s engaged in battle, its mountain of coalwill burn bright red, sending off sparks thatscorch the surrounding area.
name: Coalossal

flavor_text: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped bythis Pokémon once helped fuel the lives ofpeople in the Galar region.
name: Carkol

flavor_text: By rapidly rolling its legs, it can travel at over18 mph. The temperature of the flames itbreathes exceeds 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.
name: Carkol

flavor_text: It scatters cotton all over the place as a prank. Ifit gets wet, it’ll become too heavy to move andhave no choice but to answer for its mischief.
name: Whimsicott

flavor_text: As long as this Pokémon bathes in sunlight, itscotton keeps growing. If too much cotton fluffbuilds up, Whimsicott tears it off and scatters it.
name: Whimsicott

flavor_text: It shoots cotton from its body to protect itself.If it gets caught up in hurricane-strength winds,it can get sent to the other side of the Earth.
name: Cottonee

flavor_text: Weaving together the cotton of both Cottoneeand Eldegoss produces exquisite cloth that’shighly prized by many luxury brands.
name: Cottonee

flavor_text: Scolipede latches on to its prey with the claws onits neck before slamming them into the groundand jabbing them with its claws’ toxic spikes.
name: Scolipede

flavor_text: Scolipede engage in fierce territorial battles withCentiskorch. At the end of one of these battles,the victor makes a meal of the loser.
name: Scolipede

flavor_text: This Pokémon spins itself rapidly and charges intoits opponents. Its top speed is just over 60 mph.
name: Whirlipede

flavor_text: Whirlipede protects itself with a sturdy shell andpoisonous spikes while it stores up the energy it’llneed for evolution.
name: Whirlipede

flavor_text: Lopunny is constantly monitoring its surroundings.If danger approaches, this Pokémon respondswith superdestructive kicks.
name: Lopunny

flavor_text: Once hot seasons are over, Lopunny’s coat willbe replaced with fur that holds a lot of insulatingair in preparation for colder weather.
name: Lopunny

flavor_text: Its cries sound like incantations.Those hearing it are tormentedby headaches and hallucinations.
name: Mismagius

flavor_text: Forests where Swadloon live have superbfoliage because the nutrients they makefrom fallen leaves nourish the plant life.
name: Swadloon

flavor_text: Leavanny dress it in clothes they madefor it when it hatched. It hides its headin its hood while it is sleeping.
name: Sewaddle

flavor_text: To eat, it deftly shucks nutswith its two tails. It rarely usesits arms now.
name: Ambipom

flavor_text: Perhaps seeking company, it approaches children.However, it often quickly runs away again whenthe children play too roughly with it.
name: Drifloon

flavor_text: The gathering of many souls gave rise to thisPokémon. During humid seasons, they seem toappear in abundance.
name: Drifloon

flavor_text: Some say this Pokémon is a collection of soulsburdened with regrets, silently drifting throughthe dusk.
name: Drifblim

flavor_text: It grabs people and Pokémon and carries themoff somewhere. Where do they go?Nobody knows.
name: Drifblim

flavor_text: If both of Buneary’s ears are rolled up, somethingis wrong with its body or mind. It’s a sure sign thePokémon is in need of care.
name: Buneary

flavor_text: Buneary can attack by rolling up their ears andthen striking with the force created by unrollingthem. This attack becomes stronger with training.
name: Buneary

flavor_text: It nimbly dashes about to avoid getting peckedby bird Pokémon that would love to make offwith its small, nutrient-rich storage ball.
name: Cherubi

flavor_text: The deeper a Cherubi’s red, the more nutrients ithas stockpiled in its body. And the sweeter andtastier its small ball!
name: Cherubi

flavor_text: As a bud, it barely moves. It sits still, placidlywaiting for sunlight to appear.
name: Cherrim

flavor_text: Its folded petals are pretty tough. Bird Pokémoncan peck at them all they want, and Cherrimwon’t be bothered at all.
name: Cherrim

flavor_text: This Pokémon’s habitat shapes its physique.According to some theories, life in warm oceanwaters causes this variation to develop.
name: Shellos

flavor_text: Subjecting this Pokémon to a strong forcecauses it to secrete a strange purple fluid.Though harmless, the fluid is awfully sticky.
name: Shellos

flavor_text: Its search for food sometimes leads it onto land,where it leaves behind a sticky trail of slime as itpasses through.
name: Gastrodon

flavor_text: The softness of its body helps disperse the forceof impacts, so although its body is uncommonlysquishy, it’s also surprisingly resilient.
name: Gastrodon

flavor_text: It makes its nest at the bottom of swamps. It willeat anything—if it is alive, Whiscash will eat it.
name: Whiscash

flavor_text: It claims a large swamp to itself. If a foe comesnear it, it sets off tremors by thrashing around.
name: Whiscash

flavor_text: If you visit a beach at the end of summer, you’llbe able to see groups of Staryu lighting up in asteady rhythm.
name: Staryu

flavor_text: Fish Pokémon nibble at it, but Staryu isn’tbothered. Its body regenerates quickly, evenif part of it is completely torn off.
name: Staryu

flavor_text: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into aburning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponentshard and leave them scorched.
name: Cinderace

flavor_text: It’s skilled at both offense and defense, and itgets pumped up when cheered on. But if it startsshowboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.
name: Cinderace

flavor_text: After two Binacle find a suitably sized rock, theyadhere themselves to it and live together.They cooperate to gather food during high tide.
name: Binacle

flavor_text: If the two don’t work well together, both theiroffense and defense fall apart. Without goodteamwork, they won’t survive.
name: Binacle

flavor_text: Seven Binacle come together to form oneBarbaracle. The Binacle that serves as the headgives orders to those serving as the limbs.
name: Barbaracle

flavor_text: Having an eye on each palm allows it to keepwatch in all directions. In a pinch, its limbs startto act on their own to ensure the enemy’s defeat.
name: Barbaracle

flavor_text: It lets out billows of steam and disappears intothe dense fog. It’s said to live in mountainswhere humans do not tread.
name: Volcanion

flavor_text: This troublemaker sends anythingand everything to faraway placesusing its loop, which can warp space.
name: Hoopa

flavor_text: It excels at violent, no-holds-barred battles.The temperature of the flames that issue from itsnavel exceeds 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.
name: Incineroar

flavor_text: Incineroar’s rough and aggressive behavior is itsmost notable trait, but the way it helps out smallPokémon shows that it has a kind side as well.
name: Incineroar

flavor_text: In the midst of battle, the fire pouch onTorracat’s neck rings like a bell and producesstronger flames than usual.
name: Torracat

flavor_text: When facing a powerful enemy, Torracat’sfighting spirit gets pumped up, and its fire bellblazes hotter.
name: Torracat

flavor_text: It spends even the smallest amount of downtimegrooming its fur with its tongue. Loose fur gathersin its stomach and serves as fuel for fiery moves.
name: Litten

flavor_text: Trying to pet Litten before it trusts you willresult in a nasty scratch from its sharp claws.Be careful.
name: Litten

flavor_text: As if wielding a bow, it launches the arrow quillshidden among the feathers of its wings.Decidueye’s shots never miss.
name: Decidueye

flavor_text: In a tenth of a second, it can nock and fire anarrow quill, piercing an opponent’s weak pointbefore they notice what’s happening.
name: Decidueye

flavor_text: Honedge evolves into twins. The two bladesrub together to emit a metallic sound thatunnerves opponents.
name: Doublade

flavor_text: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidlyalternating between offense and defense tobring down their prey.
name: Doublade

flavor_text: In this defensive stance, Aegislash uses its steelbody and a force field of spectral power toreduce the damage of any attack.
name: Aegislash

flavor_text: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulateothers. It once used its powers to force peopleand Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.
name: Aegislash

flavor_text: A scent pouch within this Pokémon’s body allowsit to create various scents. A change in its dietwill alter the fragrance it produces.
name: Spritzee

flavor_text: The scent its body gives off enraptures thosewho smell it. Noble ladies had no shortage oflove for Spritzee.
name: Spritzee

flavor_text: It has short legs and can’t walk very fast, but itsneck and tentacles can extend to over threetimes their usual length to nab distant prey.
name: Cradily

flavor_text: Once Cradily catches prey in its tentacles,it digests them whole and absorbs their nutrients.
name: Cradily

flavor_text: It eats its own weight in sugar every day.If it doesn’t get enough sugar, it becomesincredibly grumpy.
name: Swirlix

flavor_text: The sweet smell of cotton candy perfumesSwirlix’s fluffy fur. This Pokémon spits outsticky string to tangle up its enemies.
name: Swirlix

flavor_text: By taking in a person’s scent, it can sniff out theirmental and physical condition. It’s hoped thatthis skill will have many medical applications.
name: Slurpuff

flavor_text: Slurpuff’s fur contains a lot of air, making it softto the touch and lighter than it looks.
name: Slurpuff

flavor_text: It spins while making its luminescent spots flash.These spots allow it to communicate with othersby using different patterns of light.
name: Inkay

flavor_text: By exposing foes to the blinking of itsluminescent spots, Inkay demoralizes them,and then it seizes the chance to flee.
name: Inkay

flavor_text: Gazing at its luminescent spots will quicklyinduce a hypnotic state, putting the observerunder Malamar’s control.
name: Malamar

flavor_text: It’s said that Malamar’s hypnotic powers playeda role in certain history-changing events.
name: Malamar

flavor_text: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar tothe sun, thus blinding its foes.
name: Solrock

flavor_text: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it isstrong during the daytime. When it spins, itsbody shines.
name: Solrock

flavor_text: Its slimy body is hard to grasp. In one region, it issaid to have been born from hardened mud.
name: Barboach

flavor_text: It probes muddy riverbeds with its two longwhiskers. A slimy film protects its body.
name: Barboach

flavor_text: This Pokémon hides in the heart of sandstormsit creates and seldom appears where peoplecan see it.
name: Flygon

flavor_text: It is nicknamed the Desert Spirit because theflapping of its wings sounds like a woman singing.
name: Flygon

flavor_text: CACNEA lives in arid locations suchas deserts. It releases a strong aromafrom its flower to attract prey.When prey comes near, this POKéMONshoots sharp thorns from its body tobring the victim down.
name: Cacnea

flavor_text: During the daytime, CACTURNE remainsunmoving so that it does not lose anymoisture to the harsh desert sun.This POKéMON becomes active at nightwhen the temperature drops.
name: Cacturne

flavor_text: Its cottony wings are full of air, making them lightand fluffy to the touch. Swablu takes diligent careof its wings.
name: Swablu

flavor_text: Since Swablu looks like a cumulus cloud, foes canhave a hard time finding it. Apparently its wingsturned white over many generations.
name: Swablu

flavor_text: As it flies in a calm and relaxed manner, Altariaperforms a humming song that would enraptureany audience.
name: Altaria

flavor_text: This Pokémon has a kind disposition, but if it’sprovoked, it will threaten opponents with shrillcries before attacking them without mercy.
name: Altaria

flavor_text: Memories of battling its arch-rivalSEVIPER are etched into every cell ofZANGOOSE’s body.This POKéMON adroitly dodges attackswith incredible agility.
name: Zangoose

flavor_text: SEVIPER shares a generations-longfeud with ZANGOOSE. The scars on itsbody are evidence of vicious battles.This POKéMON attacks using its sword-edged tail.
name: Seviper

flavor_text: The phase of the moon apparently has someeffect on its power. It’s active on the night ofa full moon.
name: Lunatone

flavor_text: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.
name: Lunatone

flavor_text: Psyduck is constantly beset by headaches. If thePokémon lets its strange power erupt apparentlythe pain subsides for a while.
name: Psyduck

flavor_text: As Psyduck gets stressed out its headache getsprogressively worse. It uses intense psychicenergy to overwhelm those around it.
name: Psyduck

flavor_text: It uses its hard incisor teeth to crush and eatberries. The tip of a female Nidorans horn is abit more rounded than the tip of a males horn.
name: Nidoran♀

flavor_text: Females are more sensitive to smells than males.While foraging theyll use their whiskers to checkwind direction and stay downwind of predators.
name: Nidoran♀

flavor_text: It can tell what people are thinking. Only Trainerswho have justice in their hearts can earn thisPokémons trust.
name: Lucario

flavor_text: It controls waves known as auras which arepowerful enough to pulverize huge rocks.It uses these waves to take down its prey.
name: Lucario

flavor_text: A warm-up of running around gets fire energycoursing through this Pokémons body. Once thathappens its ready to fight at full power.
name: Scorbunny

flavor_text: It has special pads on the backs of its feet andone on its nose. Once its raring to fight thesepads radiate tremendous heat.
name: Scorbunny

flavor_text: No wavelength of sound is beyond Noibatsability to produce. The ultrasonic waves itgenerates can overcome much larger Pokémon.
name: Noibat

flavor_text: After nightfall they emerge from the caves theynest in during the day. Using their ultrasonicwaves they go on the hunt for ripened fruit.
name: Noibat

flavor_text: It loves to baskin the sunlight.It uses the leafon its head toseek out warmplaces.
name: Chikorita

flavor_text: This Pokémon is still small and timid.Whenever Magby gets excited or surprisedflames leak from its mouth and its nose.
name: Magby

flavor_text: This Pokémon makes its home near volcanoes.At the end of the day Magby soaks in magmaresting and recovering from the days fatigue.
name: Magby

flavor_text: This Pokémon lives in dry rocky areas. As itsgreen spheres dry out their dull luster increases.
name: Bonsly

flavor_text: It expels both sweat and tears from its eyes.The sweat is a little salty while the tears havea slight bitterness.
name: Bonsly

flavor_text: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If youleave trash lying around you could even findone of these Pokémon living in your room.
name: Trubbish

flavor_text: This Pokémon was born from a bag stuffed withtrash. Galarian Weezing relish the fumes belchedby Trubbish.
name: Trubbish

flavor_text: When it goes on a rampage its impossible tocontrol. But in the presence of a Nidoqueen itslived with for a long time Nidoking calms down.
name: Nidoking

flavor_text: Nidoking prides itself on its strength. Its forcefuland spirited in battle making use of its thick tailand diamond-crushing horn.
name: Nidoking

flavor_text: For protection it releases a horrible stench fromthe antenna on its head to drive away enemies.
name: Caterpie

flavor_text: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads thatenable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.
name: Caterpie

flavor_text: Vespiquen that give off more pheromoneshave larger swarms of Combee attendants.
name: Vespiquen

flavor_text: It skillfully commands its grubs in battles with itsenemies. The grubs are willing to risk their livesto defend Vespiquen.
name: Vespiquen

flavor_text: TREECKO has small hooks on the bottomof its feet that enable it to scalevertical walls.This POKéMON attacks by slamming foeswith its thick tail.
name: Treecko

flavor_text: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyoussong. This delightful display has charmed manyinto raising this Pokémon.
name: Gossifleur

flavor_text: It anchors itself in the ground with its single legthen basks in the sun. After absorbing enoughsunlight its petals spread as it blooms brilliantly.
name: Gossifleur

flavor_text: It survives by absorbing light. After a long timespent slumbering underground impuritiesaccumulated within it causing its body to darken.
name: Necrozma

flavor_text: It needs light to survive and it goes on arampage seeking it out. Its laser beams willcut anything to pieces.
name: Necrozma

flavor_text: The more energy itcharges up thefaster it gets.But this alsomakes it morelikely to explode.
name: Electrode

flavor_text: When this Pokémons tail is soaked in watersweetness seeps from it. Slowpoke uses this traitto lure in and fish up other Pokémon.
name: Slowpoke

flavor_text: Slow-witted and oblivious this Pokémon wontfeel any pain if its tail gets eaten. It wont noticewhen its tail grows back either.
name: Slowpoke

flavor_text: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress theopposite gender. They never see use in battle.
name: Dubwool

flavor_text: Weave a carpet from its springy wool and you endup with something closer to a trampoline. Youllstart to bounce the moment you set foot on it.
name: Dubwool

flavor_text: Both of its legs have turned into wings. Without asound Crobat flies swiftly toward its prey andsinks its fangs into the nape of its targets neck.
name: Crobat

flavor_text: This Pokémon flaps its four wings skillfully.Crobat can fly through cramped caves withoutneeding to slow down.
name: Crobat

flavor_text: Its highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its caneof ice in time with its graceful movements.
